#832. 8 Survival Thrillers That Are 10/10 Masterpieces, Ranked

📅 15 Nov 2026

8 Survival Thrillers That Are 10/10 Masterpieces, Ranked

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/survival-thrillers-perfect-masterpieces/

Diungkapkan bahwa we often turn to movies to experience situations we can’t imagine in our own lives. It’s part of the thrill of a thriller. Our adrenaline races from the comfort of our seats because we don’t have to experience what the protagonists are going through. Survival thrillers depict worst-case scenarios: trying to stay alive when the odds are stacked against you.

Sebagaimana diketahui, plenty of daring survival thrillers exist throughout cinema history, but these eight titles are true masterpieces. Whether on a beach or in space, the fight to survive is central to these stories. From narratives that both inspired and took inspiration from Survivor to harrowing sci-fi thrillers about a fight to get home, these movies are enthralling from beginning to end.

Berdasarkan laporan, arriving mere months after the debut season of survivor, robert zemeckis’ survival drama cast away received an extra boost from those who pondered what would actually happen if one were stranded on a deserted island. Cast Away tells the story of Chuck Noland (Tom Hanks), a work-obsessed FedEx executive who survives a devastating plane crash and washes ashore on a completely uninhabited Pacific island. Forced to adapt to extreme isolation for four years with only a volleyball named Wilson for company, he must master basic survival skills while holding onto the hope of returning home to his fiancée, Kelly Frears (Helen Hunt). Cast Away strips the genre down to a raw, methodical examination of human endurance, time, and isolation rather than relying on over-the-top action or artificial threats.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cast away thrives for its incredible realism. Stranded alone for four years, Chuck's greatest threat isn't just nature—it's the complete absence of human voice. Chuck doesn’t master the wild at first. A genuine survival masterpiece, Cast Away has a documentary-style feel that makes the narrative quite tangible. The film gains immense satisfaction from ingenuity, showing Chuck creatively using FedEx package contents—such as ice skates for tools and videotapes for rope. Proving the necessity of connection, Wilson externalizes Chuck’s internal monologue and serves as a psychological lifeline, keeping him from descending entirely into madness. He struggles through the agonizingly slow realities of securing clean water, fashioning a stone-edge knife from rocks, opening coconuts, and spending days trying to spark a fire. Zemeckis makes the bold choice to drop the musical score almost entirely during the long middle stretch on the island, replacing it with relentless crash of waves, howling wind, and silence, which forces the audience into Chuck's claustrophobic isolation. Becoming an instant icon, Wilson, the blood-stained volleyball, becomes a crucial companion. Hanks underwent a physical transformation over a year-long production break, losing over 50 pounds and growing a beard to authentically depict the toll of malnutrition and exposure. ​​​​​​​.

Diungkapkan bahwa the evolution of leonardo dicaprio’s career has proven that risky roles are very much in his wheelhouse. Iñárritu, the Western epic follows frontiersman Hugh Glass (DiCaprio) after he survives a brutal grizzly bear attack, only for a treacherous teammate named John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy) to murder Glass's son, Hawk (Forrest Goodluck), and leave him for dead. Directed by Alejandro G. Such is the case for The Revenant. Fueled by grief and sheer willpower, Glass endures the freezing, unforgiving terrain to track down Fitzgerald and avenge his son's death. The Revenant strips survival down to a raw, punishing, and sensory-driven battle against nature and human betrayal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shot on location in extreme conditions using only natural light, cinematographer emmanuel lubezki creates a visual world that feels harsh, cold, and immediate. The film thrives on its technical elements. Glass’s physical endurance fuses with an emotional core, making the fight for survival a brutal driver of vengeance. This authenticity pulls audiences into the action as simple acts like finding water, hunting for food, crossing freezing rapids, or staying warm become high-stakes, life-or-death events. The grizzly attack scene remains one of the decade's best. The Revenant is a grueling film that keeps your heart pounding. The sound design intentionally isolates and magnifies heavy breathing, cracking ice, and wind, making the audience feel physically trapped and exhausted inside the freezing environment. ​​​​​​​.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the most harrowing true-life films of the survival thriller genre is 127 hours. Written and directed by Danny Boyle, the biographical film tells the true story of mountaineer Aron Ralston (James Franco), who becomes trapped alone in a remote Utah slot canyon when a dislodged boulder pins his arm. 127 Hours turns a static, claustrophobic nightmare into a high-energy, deeply human psychological study led by a powerhouse performance from Franco. Over the course of nearly a week, he endures severe dehydration, hallucinations, and dwindling supplies before making the agonizing choice to amputate his own arm to escape and survive. 127 Hours turns a brutal story of self-mutilation into an inspiring celebration of the human will to live.

Berdasarkan laporan, boyle turns what could have been a static chamber piece into a dynamic, adrenaline-fueled action film. By utilizing split-screens, rapid editing, dizzying camera angles, and intimate point-of-view shots, he keeps a man pinned under a rock in Bluejohn Canyon visually and viscerally gripping from minute to minute. Franco charts Ralston’s arc from a reckless, arrogant adrenaline junkie into a man stripped down to his core, confronting his past regrets, loneliness, and mortality. From how he rations his meager water and tries to chip away at the boulder to the grim mechanics of rigging a pulley system and facing the reality of self-amputation, the film is masterfully plausible. The film balances physical agony with an expansive, life-affirming triumph. By sticking closely to Ralston’s experience, the meticulous authenticity makes the danger feel painfully immediate. ​​​​​​​.

Diungkapkan bahwa jumpstarting a new horror-thriller franchise, a quiet place is a masterpiece of sci-fi post-apocalyptic storytelling. In a world overrun by blind extraterrestrial creatures that hunt by sound, the Abbott family, led by Lee and Evelyn (John Krasinski and Emily Blunt), struggle to survive in near-total silence. To protect their children and an impending newborn, they communicate via American Sign Language and navigate carefully planned paths while avoiding any accidental noise. Directed by Krasinski, A Quiet Place weaponizes silence, anchors its terror in high-stakes family dynamics, and minimizes storytelling down to pure mechanical tension.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what a quiet place does extraordinarily well is invert the horror formula. By brutally establishing the lethal cost of a single toy-rocket noise within the first ten minutes, the film ensures that every subsequent action carries immediate, life-or-death weight. The film is a raw story about two parents desperately trying to protect and raise children in an increasingly dangerous world. As far as sci-fi thrills are concerned, the “Death Angels” are kept largely mysterious and underexposed for most of the runtime, shifting the terror from what the creatures look like to the agonizing vulnerability of the human characters trying to survive. Though the sequel doesn’t match the original’s thrill, Krasinski proved his skill behind the camera. Instead of relying on jump-scare loud noises to shock the audience, the film uses near-total silence—featuring fewer than 100 spoken lines of dialogue—to make every ambient rustle, footstep, or breath feel deafeningly loud. ​​​​​​​.

Berdasarkan laporan, there have been a few dramatizations about the 1972 andes flight disaster, but society of the snow is peak perfection. Bayona and based on Pablo Vierci's 2008 book of the same name, the Spanish-language thriller tells the true story of Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571, which crashed in the remote Andes mountains in October 1972. Trapped in freezing conditions with little food, the surviving members of a rugby team must rely on teamwork, faith, and extreme measures, including consuming the deceased, to endure 72 days until a daring rescue. Directed by J. A. Society of the Snow replaces Hollywood action clichés with a grounded, visceral, and deeply empathetic account of a truly tragic real-life disaster.

Berdasarkan laporan, if there’s one thing this film brings, it's visceral realism. Survival comes through uncompromised brotherhood, shared sacrifice, and organic leadership. The narrative deliberately shifts perspective to honor every member of the rugby team, reframing survival not as a clean "happy ending," but as a complex weight carried by those who made it out. The film treats the impact with a blunt, sobering physical reality that highlights human fragility. Using tight lenses, practical shaker rigs, and raw audio-visual design, the film forces the audience inside the fuselage as metal shears and seats collapse. Rather than a tale about petty leadership rivalries or villainous infighting among survivors, Bayona makes it clear that the sole antagonist is the indifferent, monumental Andes mountain range. The opening plane crash sequence is widely regarded as one of the most terrifying and technically accurate scenes in cinema history. ​​​​​​​.

Berdasarkan laporan, in space, no one can hear you scream, but you can watch people sweat as they did in alfonso cuarón's masterpiece gravity. Ryan Stone (Sandra Bullock) and veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski (George Clooney) as they fight to survive after a destructive cloud of satellite debris wrecks their space shuttle in low Earth orbit. Left completely stranded in the silent void of space with rapidly depleting resources, they must navigate a harrowing journey from station to station to find a way back home. The film tells the story of medical engineer Dr. One of the best space-set survival thrillers of all time, Gravity is a masterclass in the genre because it merges relentless physical peril with a deeply resonant emotional journey of human resilience.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, instead of a space thriller centered around extraterrestrial creatures, the story is rooted in a scientifically grounded, terrifyingly plausible nightmare. Gravity establishes a clock with rapidly depleting oxygen, failing power, and severed communications, making every single second feel dangerous and earned. From its famous opening unbroken take that floats and spins around the astronauts, the camera work places the audience directly inside the microgravity environment. The story operates as a metaphor for rebirth and grief. Her physical struggle to breathe, stand, and re-enter Earth's atmosphere mirrors an internal rebirth. Stone is fighting her way back from the emotional vacuum of grief after the death of her child. You feel the vertigo, the silence of space, and the sheer helplessness of drifting into the void. A minimalist, high-stakes drama, Gravity is a pure exercise in problem-solving under extreme duress.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the newest entry into the survival thriller, send help is an absolute blast of a movie. As their toxic workplace power dynamic dramatically inverts, the struggle for survival turns into a ruthless, darkly humorous battle of wits where morality quickly shatters. Directed by Sam Raimi, the black comedy follows Linda Liddle (Rachel McAdams), an overworked analyst, and Bradley Preston (Dylan O’Brien), her arrogant, newly appointed CEO boss, who become the sole survivors of a plane crash on a remote jungle island. Subverting expectations, this genre-bending survival thriller replaces standard wilderness mechanics with a sharp, psychologically dark examination of workplace power dynamics.

Sebagaimana diketahui, capturing raimi’s signature style, get help blends gritty tension, gross-out horror, and pitch-black dark comedy, keeping the narrative unpredictable and unhinged from moment to moment as the story evolves into a terrifying conceit: linda’s personal game of survivor. Rather than treating the island as a trial to escape, Linda actively curates dependency, controls Bradley, and suppresses her urge to flag down passing rescue boats to stay in power. McAdams plays Linda with a chilling lack of easy likability, framing her motivation not as simple revenge, but as a compulsive psychological need to push back against a lifetime of systemic erasure. Beyond the survival moments is a pitch-perfect exploration into psychological power plays. With a sensationally twisted conclusion, Send Help asks a deeply uncomfortable question: does society applaud survival only when it is convenient? ​​​​​​​.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a classic across multiple genres, the martian is a brilliant story of resiliency in the face of survival. Directed by Ridley Scott and based on Andy Weir’s novel, during a mission to Mars, astronaut Mark Watney (Matt Damon) is accidentally left behind and presumed dead by his crew after a violent dust storm forces an emergency evacuation. Stranded alone on the harsh planet, he uses his scientific knowledge and ingenuity to grow food and signal to Earth that he survived. Meanwhile, NASA teams and his former crewmates race against time to pull off a dangerous rescue mission to bring him home. The Martian works as a survival thriller by celebrating human ingenuity, real-world science, and relentless optimism.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the film treats actual science and engineering as the central protagonist. Stranded botanist and astronaut Watney has to calculate calorie counts, synthesize water from hydrazine, manage atmospheric pressure, and engineer potato crops using Martian soil and biological waste. It not only raises the stakes but also maintains relentless momentum, ensuring every narrative ripple matters. The dual-track narrative seamlessly intercuts between Watney’s lonely, day-to-day struggle on the surface of Mars and the frantic, globe-spanning rescue operations at NASA and aboard the Hermes spacecraft. Everyone—from Watney fighting to stay alive to the NASA scientists, international space agencies, and his former crewmates risking their careers—shares a singular, united goal: bring him home. At the end of the day, the thrills are fulfilling, but sharing a moment of optimism and hope is The Martian’s greatest gift.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, i hate to ruin the magic, but disneyland snow isn’t actually snow. It’s something that’s been named "snoap" by fans, because it’s practically soap disguised as snow. It's dispersed by hidden rooftop machines.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to the los angeles times, disneyland’s snow is made up of 98% water mixed with a non-hazardous, proprietary surfactant (soap) blend. However, when too much water mixes with it, you get a very soapy (and gross) ground!.

#836. 9 Giant-Sized Changes Marvel Made to Ant-Man After Edgar Wright Left

📅 15 Nov 2026

9 Giant-Sized Changes Marvel Made to Ant-Man After Edgar Wright Left

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/edgar-wright-ant-man-script-differences/

Unsurprisingly, that Falcon cameo would not have been in there.

Diungkapkan bahwa in may 2014, it was announced that edgar wright, best known for movies like shaun of the dead and scott pilgrim vs. The news was shocking because Wright was not just a director-for-hire like some Marvel filmmakers have been. the World, would no longer be directing Marvel’s Ant-Man movie. Wright first began crafting his Ant-Man film with co-writer Joe Cornish in the early 2000s, before the Marvel Cinematic Universe was even a thing. When the MCU began to develop, Wright’s Ant-Man was one of the earliest confirmed projects. Wright was even a part of the MCU’s first panel back in 2006.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as wright has explained in interviews, he was excited to be on the ground floor of something, setting the tone for what the mcu would become. He wanted to do a superhero movie where it was still emblematic of the director, in keeping with their body of work. After leaving Ant-Man, Wright even told Variety, “I wanted to make a Marvel movie but I don’t think they really wanted to make an Edgar Wright movie. The comparison he’d made was Tim Burton’s Batman, which is still very much a Tim Burton movie. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa part of the problem was timing. But Wright asked that Ant-Man be pushed back so that he could direct The World’s End first. Ant-Man was originally a Phase One MCU movie, with only loose connective tissue to the other films. This was because his producing partner, Eric Fellner, had been diagnosed with cancer and he wanted to finish their “Cornetto Trilogy” while Fellner still could.

Berdasarkan laporan, marvel agreed and ant-man moved to phase two, after the blockbuster success of avengers and when marvel’s “house style” had already been established. As Wright and Cornish were updating their drafts of the film and casting the major parts, Marvel kept pushing for more connections with the MCU. Eventually, Marvel had one of its in-house screenwriters do a draft without Wright’s involvement. This eventually resulted in Wright's departure, and director Peyton Reed took his place. Paul Rudd, who was already cast as Scott Lang, then did a rewrite with Adam McKay, which became the film we now know.

Berdasarkan laporan, to be clear, a good amount of wright and cornish’s script survived and served as the film’s overall backbone. According to Reed, “The idea to make Ant-Man a heist movie structure was all Edgar and Joe. The idea of Hank Pym and Scott Lang as mentor and pupil, again, that was all theirs, and also, the idea of a movie that that all drives toward a third act where the big battle between the good guy and the bad guy takes place in a little girl's bedroom, that was always there from the beginning, and I stand by the fact that I think that's genius. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa still, there were a lot of changes, and while we’ve never seen the original script (and wright has said he has to be careful about revealing too much because of the nda he signed) there’s enough out there to give us a pretty good idea of the differences. Here are the nine biggest changes from Edgar Wright's Ant-Man to the one we got.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the version of ant-man that we got, scott lang’s crew for pulling off heists was just three guys, but according to the film’s editor colby parker jr. , “I think there were, like, 15 people within the gang. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, michael peña’s character luis did exist in wright’s version, but in a much smaller capacity, most likely because scott lang’s crew would have been so much bigger. But as the movie took a new direction under Reed, his part grew and once they got into reshoots, his character grew even more. Even that famous summary montage Luis did was a late addition.

Berdasarkan laporan, this one probably isn't a big surprise, as falcon's fight with ant-man definitely feels shoehorned into the movie. Wright’s version had far less crossover with the existing MCU. I think he was going to be a standalone. As Parker Jr. He didn't want any other Marvel characters in the film. told The Direct, "I don't think there would have been any other Marvel characters set up. ” Parker Jr. even specifically pointed to the scene, saying, “I don't think the Falcon would have been in Ant-Man.

According to the book MCU: The Reign of Marvel Studios, Edgar Wright’s Ant-Man would have begun with a flashback to Hank Pym (Michael Douglas) as the original Ant-Man, then it would have jumped to the present day with Scott Lang stealing the suit.

With Wright opening on Pym as Ant-Man, the movie would not have featured the scene with Hank Pym fighting with Peggy Carter and Howard Stark about trying to replicate his Pym Particles.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as peyton reed told vulture, “in the original drafts i think there was one reference in dialogue to janet. ” While Janet Van Dyne — who would eventually come to be played by Michelle Pfeiffer in Ant-Man and the Wasp — only appears briefly in Ant-Man, her absence informs much of Hank Pym’s arc with his daughter Hope (Evangeline Lilly) and builds into the Quantum Realm story for the sequel. She didn’t appear in the movie. Speaking of which….

Diungkapkan bahwa “we also brought the quantum realm into the movie, which was never in the early drafts,” reed told vulture. What if we got to the third act and we took it even further?’ We found a way to work that into the story with the self-sacrifice that Scott makes to save his daughter, but it also leaves Hank Pym with this realization that Scott got out of the quantum realm, something he didn’t think was possible. We thought, ‘There’s gonna be a lot of shrinking in this movie. “That mostly came about because Adam and I love that psychedelic part of Marvel Comics. ”.

Considering how important the quantum realm is to the MCU, especially for Avengers: Endgame, it’s clear that Wright’s departure didn’t just change Ant-Man, it changed the entire MCU.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the final version of ant-man, scott lang is an ex-con in the very loosest sense, having committed some anti-corporate crime where he did some robin hood kind of thing, stealing corporate money and giving it to people who had been scammed by the company. But in Wright’s version, Lang started out as an “actual criminal,” Wright explained on his Instagram, with a greater redemption arc throughout the film. This undoubtedly would have changed the character, and probably would have made him a bit more interesting.

Berdasarkan laporan, evangeline lilly, who came onto the film as hope van dyne because of edgar wright, was a big supporter of his and almost left the film in solidarity. It just would have taken you away from this cohesive universe they’re trying to create. Eventually, she was convinced to stay on and, after having seen the finished film directed by Reed, she told The Hollywood Reporter that Wright's version “wouldn’t have fit in the Marvel Universe. It would have stuck out like a sore thumb, no matter how good it was. ”.

#837. 10 Best Cowboys & Cowgirls In The Yellowstone Franchise

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Best Cowboys & Cowgirls In The Yellowstone Franchise

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/yellowstone-best-cowboy-cowgirls/

Berdasarkan laporan, faith roswell is a senior writer on screen rant's classic tv team. Faith now combines her knowledge of psychology with her love of monster movies to give more insight into what makes the best ones. Since earning her degree in Creative Writing over a decade ago, Faith has written articles on film and TV from a variety of different angles. You may have read her Screen Rant lists and features covering horror, sci-fi, and fantasy, or read her Amazon Top 10 book, "Movie Monsters of the Deep. " Faith has had an extensive career as a writer, appearing on BBC live radio, researching true crime for Rotten Mango podcast, and writing for publications including Mental Floss, Atlas Obscura, and The Daily Jaws before beginning here at Screen Rant.

Diungkapkan bahwa yellowstone's dutton ranch is the heart and soul of the series, and while classic westerns often romanticize the life of a cowboy, the shows in taylor sheridan's yellowstone franchise embrace the grit and harsh conditions that come with working in such a stunning location. The iconic Yellowstone brand perfectly represents this, with the ranch employing a large staff of cowboys but relatively few having the honor of wearing it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the franchise is not always realistic, but one aspect that has repeatedly been true to life is the casting, with yellowstone casting real cowboys to play some of the ranch hands, which is why so many of the show's actors appear so comfortable with horse riding, rodeo, and even the occasional stunts. This, combined with the performances of the main actors in the series, has ensured that the messy, intense, and demanding job of working as a cowboy or cowgirl earns the respect of the audience, no matter which Yellowstone TV show is playing.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a character, ethan is likely a better cowboy than is shown onscreen, as he came to appear in yellowstone through other jobs on the set. Actor and horse trainer Ethan Lee was initially a stunt double, consultant, and mentor for the show, and with the main actors needing to appear highly competent in their roles, he ran cowboy "boot camps" for the cast, sharing his expertise.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ethan earned his brand by the end of yellowstone's third season, proving him a trusted employee and ranch hand at dutton ranch. That said, much of Lee's work on the show was done outside of playing the character sharing his name and viewers have not had much of a chance to judge his character's individual work, which is why Ethan has such a low rank on this list.

Sebagaimana diketahui, laramie came to dutton ranch with an already established and respected career as a barrel racer, but despite clearly being capable of carrying out the work needed on the ranch, her competence as a cowgirl was quickly overshadowed by love triangle storylines. Laramie was a polarizing character for this reason, and opinions were divided over whether she was an undeveloped character orbiting the more interesting cowboys, or a modern cowgirl who refused to conform to the hierarchy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when lloyd and walker's fight over laramie resulted in women being barred from the bunkhouse, laramie could have chosen a different career, but instead, she left dutton ranch to continue barrel racing on the rodeo circuit. This proved her to be a competent cowgirl with a future working with horses, reflecting the real-life abilities of actor Hassie Harrison, who grew up on a cattle ranch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, actor and musician ryan bingham began a rodeo career at age 17 and, after meeting taylor sheridan while working on the soundtrack for his movie wind river, sheridan wrote the role of walker into yellowstone for him. Walker received his brand in the show's first season, instantly establishing his high status both as a cowboy and as the closest thing to family on the ranch.

In addition to playing Walker, Bingham has also contributed to the Yellowstone soundtrack.

Sebagaimana diketahui, walker is clearly good at his job and seen riding horses and working cattle, but he is also able to teach other characters, like beth, to be better riders, which sets him above the other ranch hands in the series. That said, Walker's heart is not necessarily in ranch life, as the character is an aspiring country singer who does not always support the extreme measures taken by the Duttons.

Berdasarkan laporan, jake ream was a horse trainer and cowboy long before he worked on yellowstone, first meeting taylor sheridan when he sold him a horse. Ream gave lessons to Sheridan and his family, and like Ethan Lee, he also ran the cowboy boot camp sessions for the show's main actors. This led to Ream gradually taking on a greater role in the series, first appearing at the end of the first season and getting his brand in the third.

Berdasarkan laporan, ream's character shares his name, and jake is portrayed as a strong and dependable character regularly seen performing genuine ranch tasks on camera, from roping cattle to working in the bunkhouse. That said, he does not have the intense and dramatic plotlines that many of the other characters do, resulting in him fading into the background despite being one of Dutton Ranch's best workers and continuing life as a cowboy after the Yellowstone finale.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unlike most of the other cowboys and cowgirls in the yellowstone franchise, 1883's elsa dutton was not born into training for this life. That said, as a naturally gifted horsewoman, she takes to frontier life and learns through experience, becoming an excellent cowgirl through her own drive and ambition rather than through expectation. Taking place over just one season, her transformation is dramatic, going from a wagon passenger to a fierce protector of the cattle herd.

Sebagaimana diketahui, elsa is easily one of the best dutton family members, and her overarching storyline is arguably the most tragic in the series for her wasted potential. Had Elsa survived, she could have been one of the most formidable and talented cowgirls in the family, as she was quickly able to hold her own with experienced cowboys like Ennis and even earned the respect of the veteran trailhands.

Berdasarkan laporan, teeter's introduction instantly proved her a talented cowgirl, with rip hiring her after seeing her competing in a rodeo where she ropes a bull in record time. That said, on arriving at Dutton Ranch, Teeter appeared set up to be little more than comic relief at best and a hot mess at worst, but she became one of the best characters in Yellowstone for her work ethic, ability, and refusal to be sidelined for being female.

Berdasarkan laporan, unlike laramie, teeter is seen taking on much of the heavy labor around dutton ranch, including branding, roping, and handling cattle, as well as riding on horseback. Having worked twice as hard to prove herself as capable as the cowboys, she finds herself in demand, working on other ranches throughout the series and finally moving to Texas' Bosque Ranch to continue life as a cowgirl after Yellowstone's finale.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dutton ranch's stoic and imposing foreman is one of the best neo-western protagonists of all time, with an antihero streak. His status among the Dutton family is already established in Yellowstone's first episode, when he gives a character the choice between incarceration or being branded and working at the ranch. Rip choosing his own workers like this instantly shows that he demonstrated his own trustworthiness long ago, and his role goes far beyond just those of a cowboy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rip's duties are much more than those of a typical ranch hand. He handles the herd movements and tracking of cattle, manages and looks after the other workers, and acts as the enforcer for Dutton Ranch. He is responsible for the smooth running of virtually every aspect of the ranch, and while he does not have specialist rodeo skills, the abilities he has make him invaluable to both the Dutton family and to the series.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, forrie j. Smith comes from a family of rodeo riders and began his career at just eight years old, gaining more real-life experience as a cowboy than most of the characters in Yellowstone have. Smith spent years riding in rodeos before his talent saw him taking on stunt work, leading him to Taylor Sheridan, who offered him a role in Yellowstone after seeing him doing stunts and wrangling in Hell or High Water.

Diungkapkan bahwa smith plays lloyd pierce, dutton ranch's resident mentor and one of the oldest ranch hands, seen during the first season and becoming a fan favorite over the course of the show. Unlike some of the other characters played by real-life cowboys, Yellowstone makes use of Smith's experience by showcasing his exceptional riding, which easily illustrates why he is the most respected of the show's many cowboys.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 1923's jacob dutton, the great, great uncle of john dutton, spent decades transforming the family's cattle empire, and while he is technically considered a rancher, he remains one of the yellowstone franchise's best cowboys in terms of his competence and skills. Rather than leaving the hands-on work to the wranglers, Jacob rides with them, personally managing grazing rotations and handling the livestock directly, but there is more to his experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, jacob knows every aspect of life as a cowboy, from the heavy ranch work and riding duties, to the law, making him a formidable character to challenge. He understands the entire business from the ground up, and it is his determination to make something more of the business that led to Dutton Ranch being the success it became. Kevin Costner gave one of the best performances in any Taylor Sheridan show while playing Jacob, making the character an icon.

Berdasarkan laporan, taylor sheridan regularly appears in his yellowstone franchise and adds some extra authenticity to his role as travis wheatley, as he is also a cowboy himself and a part owner of the four sixes ranch that is featured in the series. Wheatley is a rodeo rider and an elite horse trainer and trader who often does business with Dutton Ranch, and his abilities are fully on display in some of Yellowstone's best horse riding scenes.

Yellowstone is based on Taylor Sheridan's childhood coming from a ranching family.

Sebagaimana diketahui, travis' standout scenes showcase sheridan's expert horse riding and cutting experience, with travis impressing beth by isolating a single cow from a herd, entering a competition alongside rip and fellow trainer matt, and demonstrating his knowledge of his industry by explaining bloodlines and pricing. In terms of pure horsemanship and cowboy skills, Travis is the best in the Yellowstone franchise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, yellowstone is a neo-western drama series created by taylor sheridan and john linson, centered on the dutton family and their fight to protect the yellowstone dutton ranch from various adversaries, including land developers and nearby reservations. Premiering in 2018 on Paramount Network, the show has been praised for its depiction of power struggles, family loyalty, and rural conflicts. It has expanded into a franchise with spin-offs such as 1883 and 1923, and an upcoming sequel series is in development.

#841. CBS’ New ‘Lincoln Lawyer’ Replacement Just Proved Network TV Isn’t Dead

📅 15 Nov 2026

CBS’ New ‘Lincoln Lawyer’ Replacement Just Proved Network TV Isn’t Dead

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/cupertino-lincoln-lawyer-replacement-network-tv-success/

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i’m not dead!” the quote comes from the "bring out your dead" plague cart scene from the iconic film monty python and the holy grail, where an old man repeatedly insists he hasn’t yet shuffled off this mortal coil. The rookie series has found an audience, doubling its viewership with the pilot episode reaching 10. What keeps it alive are shows like the new Lincoln Lawyer replacement from CBS, Cupertino. Yet it could just as easily apply to network television, which refuses to go away despite the dominance of streaming. 58 million viewers, the latest evidence that there’s still life on network TV.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cupertino is a great show and is certainly worthy of the attention it’s receiving, particularly with its perfect 100% on rotten tomatoes. 9 million viewers. It’s also not alone: fellow CBS legal drama Matlock isn’t all that far behind at 93%, with the Season 2 premiere bringing in 11. The thing is, the reason behind these successes isn’t exactly rocket science. Cupertino and Matlock have nailed the essentials.

Diungkapkan bahwa that begins with the writing. Cupertino is the latest venture from Robert and Michelle King, the duo behind The Good Wife and Elsbeth, and what their shows all have in common is their penchant for sharp, smart, and clever writing. The banter is quick; the legal tricks of the trade are interesting, plausible, and engaging (even fun); and, more prominent in Elsbeth, a fearless embrace of the quirky.

Sebagaimana diketahui, writing, however, is only half of it: without the right cast, the words become inconsequential. Mike Colter, who worked with the Kings on the stellar Evil, is great as Michael Price, an attorney whose expulsion from a Silicon Valley start-up prompts him to open a practice devoted to clients who have been wronged by the technology giants in the area. Thankfully, it’s another essential that they’ve perfected. He commands the screen when he’s on it, a gentle giant of a man with a clever legal mind and a heart.

It's about to get personal for Price, Siffre & Associates this Thursday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and rachel keller, who plays his young partner, olivia siffre, balances a character who is enthusiastic, thinks outside the box, and a christian on television that isn’t a stereotype, with an enchanting ease. Ella Stiller brings the quirk as Michael’s assistant Christy, and the addition of the talented Busy Philipps is a home run. It shows that when the writing and the cast is excellent, people will tune in to watch, whether it’s on streaming or on network television.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at first glance, cupertino is a traditional legal drama, hitting the same marks as any other legal drama. Like The Lincoln Lawyer before it, Cupertino is focused on an upstart law firm starting from scratch, which is a rarity in the genre to begin with. But on its premise alone, Cupertino already stands out from its kin. And they lean into it, too, working out where to get office space, which clients can pay up front, and so on, instead of already having the capital to hit the ground running.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the fact that the law firm is the david to the big tech goliaths of silicon valley, though, is fresh and, most importantly, timely. The questions and conflicts that arise in Cupertino are more in line with real-world concerns and situations. That points to the one big advantage that network television has over streaming. An AI who is looking to hire a law firm to have his safeguards reinstalled, for example, or a trial that takes place entirely on cellphones due to a traffic jam.

Berdasarkan laporan, because streamers typically drop all their episodes for a season at once, they run the risk of being slightly behind the zeitgeist. Network television programs, however, still shoot episodes as the season is being aired, allowing for last-minute changes that are, again, timely. Is it a big advantage? Not necessarily, but it shouldn’t be dismissed outright either. The key is quality, after all, and as long as network television continues to make that a priority, as they have with Cupertino, then the Grim Reaper will just have to wait.

Stephen King’s Underrated 1980 Horror Thriller Gets New Prime Video Adaptation

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/stephen-king-prime-video-crouch-end-tv-show/

King's cosmic horror story is getting a brand-new adaptation.

Diungkapkan bahwa stephen king fans are eating well, with mike flanagan's adaptation of carrie turning out to be a surprise hit, a second season of it: welcome to derry on the way, and a series based on the dark tower books in the works. But that's not all King fans can look forward to.

Sebagaimana diketahui, prime video is reportedly developing a limited series based on king's horror-sci-fi short story crouch end. P. Considered an homage to H. Lovecraft, the story first appeared in the New Tales of the Cthulhu Mythos anthology, and was later published in King’s Nightmares & Dreamscapes short story collection. It bears the distinction of not being set in King's native Maine, like many of his works, but rather in London.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the series' official synopsis reads: “london never sleeps deeply, and its dreams are uneasy. When global movie star Doris Freeman bursts into a London police station claiming that strange phenomena are behind the disappearance of her husband, police inspector Ted Vetter must investigate whether she’s telling the truth, whether she could be a murderer, or whether there’s something even more chilling at play…”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the six-part adaptation is created by paul tomalin (bodies) and directed by tom shankland (berlin noir). Variety confirms its producers include Mammoth Screen (The Serpent), and Fifth Season (Severance), while its executive producers are Paul Tomalin, Ben Irving, Rebecca Keane, Damien Timmer, and Tom Shankland.

Sebagaimana diketahui, tomalin and shankland's project is far from the first time that crouch end has received an adaptation. The short story was also adapted as an episode of TNT's Nightmares & Dreamscapes: From the Stories of Stephen King in 2006, starring Eion Bailey as Lonnie Freeman and Claire Forlani as Doris Freeman. While Crouch End is certainly short enough to fit into a single episode, Shankland and Tomalin's adaptation will have room to explore more of the themes of grief, trauma, and cosmic horror.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i’ve been a stephen king super-fan forever," shankland said in a statement. "The chance to work with this great team and bring his utterly brilliant London mystery to life is beyond exciting – Crouch End will be cinematic, original and thought-provoking in equal measure. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa tomalin added: "after reading ‘crouch end’ some years back, stephen king’s vivid prose has haunted my nightmares ever since. Having the honour to adapt it with the incredible team at Mammoth, Fifth Season and Amazon alongside director Tom Shankland is a dream come true. I couldn’t be more excited to bring this thrilling tale to the screen. ”.

Sit back and go on a wild ride with Maximum Overdrive.

Berdasarkan laporan, in addition to being a supernatural mystery and crime-thriller, crouch end also draws on the cthulhu mythos of h. P. Lovecraft — meaning there will be plenty of grotesque imagery and horror alongside its mystery and crime elements.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nicole clemens, the vice president of international originals at prime video and amazon mgm studios, said in a statement: "stephen king is one of the defining storytellers of our time, and we’re thrilled to bring his lovecraftian tale to life in london with crouch end. Paul Tomalin brings a singular, character-driven vision to the series and, paired with Tom Shankland at the helm, plus the first-class production teams at Mammoth Screen and Fifth Season, this show will grip audiences worldwide with its visceral crime thriller and supernatural mystery. ".

Crouch End does not have a confirmed release date.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with so many major video game anniversaries being celebrated this year, it's easy to forget that resident evil is among them, with a staggering 3 decades since the release of the first game in the beloved franchise. Berdasarkan laporan, over the last few years, it has certainly felt like capcom has been building towards something quite specific rather than just treading water and bringing players new experiences within the ip. Now, we have had confirmation from the developer themselves about what exactly they plan to do in the coming years, and it's safe to say the fans should be in for a very exciting time if all of it comes to fruition.

As first reported by Polygon, Yahoo Japan sat down with the Resident Evil franchise's creative director, Jun Takeuchi, and he laid out exactly what the timeline is going to look like for the series moving forward, as well as giving us an idea of what their plans are for the overarching narrative.

Berdasarkan laporan, "with the release of requiem this year, i feel like the first 10 years have come to a close, so i think the conclusion will come in the next 10 years," takeuchi said. "I can't say because it would spoil the fun for everyone, but there won't be just one. There will be multiple titles. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, that's obviously brilliant news in and of itself, as if we get several titles of requiem's quality in the next few years, then we could arguably be entering a golden era for the series. Interestingly, Takeuchi also made it clear that the remakes we have seen so far have been deliberately chosen to facilitate the story from here, and they have made subtle changes to bring that on further.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we've always slightly altered the original storylines in our re remakes. When we were planning "RE:2" (the remake of 2) and creating a 10-year branding concept, this was the most challenging aspect. I hope you'll look forward to seeing the true nature of Spencer (the mastermind behind the series)," he said. These differences gradually become meaningful. If you play through all of them, I think you'll realize the meaning behind the order of the remakes. "The series' story wasn't planned out from the beginning; it expanded with each new game. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, they are certainly interesting tidbits, even if he wouldn't be drawn on the specifics of what is to come yet. It does sound like we might not be too far away from another announcement at the very least, with most expecting that to be a full reveal of the now confirmed Code Veronica remake.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, given resident evil's importance to the video game ecosystem as a whole, particularly in the late-90s and early-2000s, it is really nice to see it become so relevant to fans again. It has certainly been through some ups and downs as a series over the years, but it's absolutely on a more certain footing now than it has been in some time, and that can only be encouraging for the future.

Berdasarkan laporan, the pic, based on james graham’s play and adapted screenplay that tells the story of rupert murdoch and editor larry lamb’s takeover of the british tabloid the sun in the late 1960s, setting the tone for new kind of journalism in the process, was unable to show the headlines owing to britain’s stringent libel laws. Berdasarkan laporan, boyle pointed to one specific headline in the epilogue that was redacted in uk versions of the pic, above an article about the 1989 death of 97 fans crushed while trying to enter hillsborough stadium to watch a liverpool-nottingham forest fa cup soccer game. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “there are various headlines … at the end of [ink], and there’s one particular, which although it won’t mean anything to you, to anybody from britain it does mean a great deal, which is that the sun ran a terrible headline called ‘the truth,’ which is one of the principal concerns of james graham’s screenplay throughout the whole film,” boyle said. We have these redacted versions, but know that we’re in America. “[The Sun] ran this headline, and it was a bunch of lies about the way that Liverpool fans were killed at the Hillsborough disaster,” he continued. “It’s one of the low points of British journalism, and we wanted that to be always in the film, and we weren’t able to have it in the British version. #858. Michael Jackson Movie Sequel Faces A Bigger Challenge Than The First Film

📅 15 Nov 2026

Michael Jackson Movie Sequel Faces A Bigger Challenge Than The First Film

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/michael-jackson-movie-sequel-bigger-challenge-first-film/

Diungkapkan bahwa lionsgate's 2026 musical biopic michael brought the life and legacy of the king of pop, michael jackson, to the big screen in perhaps the largest way any movie has done so far, and now, they will be trying to replicate that feat in the upcoming michael sequel movie that is already confirmed to be in the works. Michael was a fascinating release when it hit theaters this April. Although some reviews of Michael were very positive, most of them effectively tore the movie apart, for a range of reasons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, among the biggest complaints were the movie's seeming avoidance of jackson's real-life controversies (although, notably, the movie concludes before many of those events transpired, chronologically) as well as related criticisms that the movie glorifies jackson and avoids any thornier, more negative traits or moments from his life. However, audiences had an overwhelmingly positive response to the movie by comparison. To put it in perspective, the critic score on Rotten Tomatoes is a bleak 38%, representing 312 reviews, whereas the audience score is a staggering 97%, accounting for more than 25,000 ratings.

Diungkapkan bahwa that division isn't likely to go anywhere in the michael sequel, which has been given the working title of michael 2, although a different final title is almost certainly coming. In fact, this upcoming movie, which will very likely focus on the remainder of Jackson's life until his death in 2009, has a significantly more daunting task ahead of it, as the very events that critics complained were absent in Michael will, by necessity, be appearing in Michael 2. In addition to the controversies, that means some of the most significant moments of the star's very complicated life.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, michael concludes in 1988, during jackson's bad tour. At the time, this choice was, in part, what led to such harsh backlash from many critics, as it seemed like Michael had intentionally ended then, before any allegations about Jackson emerged. It wasn't yet known that Michael was getting a sequel. Presumably, Michael 2 would pick up soon after that conclusion, but whether there's a slight jump forward in time or not, a sequel that highlights the remainder of Jackson's life will have some very choppy waters to navigate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for one thing, jackson went on to have three children, paris, prince, and bigi, with paris and prince born in the late 1990s and bigi being born in 2002—meaning that all three births come after the conclusion of michael. There is some question about whether the movie is going to include his children, as there may be some objections from within the family (although, for now, those conversations are largely speculative chatter), but it feels next to impossible that they won't be present at all; they were, understandably, a huge part of his life.

Of course, the 90s and 00s also saw the release of some of Jackson's most famous songs and albums from throughout his life and the emergence of the first allegation of child sexual abuse against Jackson, none of which is going to be easy to capture on the big screen, for very different reasons.

Diungkapkan bahwa michael concluding in 1988 means that some of jackson's best songs were released after that movie's end. Along with many others, that album included the song "Black or White," which continues to be one of Jackson's best-known and most celebrated songs today. Among the most notable releases following the conclusion of Michael was his studio album Dangerous, which was released in 1991. Also released after Michael's conclusion was his final studio album of new material during his lifetime, Invincible.

Diungkapkan bahwa found an error? send it info@screenrant. com so it can be corrected.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, michael already proved that lionsgate is up to the difficult task of bringing concert-level experiences to the screen even as the biopic follows a narrative arc. In fact, this was among the reasons that many audience members loved it; chatter online and audience ratings suggest that many Michael Jackson fans felt it was the closest they could come to seeing him in concert again. In that sense, Michael 2 will just have to repeat that success. That's easier said than done, of course, but it's far from the most daunting obstacle the sequel movie has ahead.

Berdasarkan laporan, the single biggest obstacle facing michael 2 is the fact that the film will absolutely have to address the multiple allegations of child sexual abuse made against jackson in his lifetime. Already, there have been discussions about why those stories weren't in Michael, from the timeline of that movie to the fact that certain stories could not appear in the film for legal reasons. However, considering that Michael 2 is set after 1988, there is just no way around it, and, in addition to being incredibly sensitive, serious subject matter, this is going to require a tonal shift from Michael.

Diungkapkan bahwa critics weren't wrong that michael has a largely positive, upbeat tone that does center michael as a loving, fun, kind-hearted character who has been wronged by many people. While there are those who would agree with that representation of Michael Jackson and those who wouldn't, there is no conceivable way that Michael 2 can move forward with the same depiction of Jackson and his life that the first movie had—at least, it can't without being much more seriously criticized even than Michael was.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, additionally, michael 2 will have to take some sort of stance on the allegations made against jackson and whether they were true. Notably, Jackson was found not guilty in court. However, the court of public opinion is another matter, and many feel that the allegations were true (not to mention the fact that a court ruling does not automatically mean that something is true or untrue). Michael 2 will inevitably anger those who hold one belief or the other—or, potentially, those on both sides of the argument.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this may actually alienate the very fanbase that loved michael, if the movie suggests the allegations were true or even leaves that in question. On the other hand, if Michael 2 suggests that the allegations were false or largely sweeps the allegations under the rug, then it will only intensify the criticism and backlash from Michael. In either case, Michael 2 has a very difficult path ahead.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, assuming that michael 2 takes the story all the way to the singer's death in 2009, which feels more likely than not, then it will also have the monumental task of somehow providing an "end" to the story, although arguably, there hasn't been one, even now. For one, in terms of the aforementioned controversies, those legal battles continue, with new updates and even new allegations over the years following Jackson's death.

Berdasarkan laporan, additionally, it's difficult to capture what jackson has meant globally and the profound impact he continues to have on pop culture. That is perhaps what made Michael so impressive already; Michael Jackson is an incredibly complex public figure, and capturing those complexities on screen is no easy feat. He is seen by many as the true greatest of all time, and he has continued to influence the music industry and beyond, long after his death (and the conclusion of that legacy doesn't seem to be arriving anytime soon). The question simply remains, can Michael 2 pull it off?.

#864. 18-Part 'The Crown Meets Bridgerton' Series Is Hands Down Netflix's Best Historical Drama

📅 15 Nov 2026

18-Part 'The Crown Meets Bridgerton' Series Is Hands Down Netflix's Best Historical Drama

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/the-empress-netflix-best-historical-drama/

Sebagaimana diketahui, memory ngulube joined screen rant in april 2024 as part of the movies and tv team. Memory is currently a Classic TV writer. Before joining Screen Rant, Memory was a freelance copywriter who specialized in email marketing and social media management. While she enjoyed her job, her true passion was always movies and TV. Since then, she has written for the Perennials and Streaming team, covering a wide range of topics from new releases to old movies and TV shows. When she isn’t writing for Screen Rant, Memory can be found reading, baking (which is one of her passions), or watching her favorite K-drama.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when the crown premiered on netflix in 2016, it immediately piqued audience interest. After all, who doesn't love a show that delves into the lives of one of the world's most powerful families? The beloved historical drama didn't survive unscathed, but overall, it performed well with audiences and critics alike. To this day, The Crown is considered to be one of Netflix’s best period dramas.

Diungkapkan bahwa bridgerton, on the other hand, gained popularity thanks to its steamy, heartfelt romances and alternate-history regency-era setting. Though not based on a true story, the Shonda Rhimes show is magnetic, offering viewers diverse, tantalizing romances and family drama. While it's not as popular as Bridgerton or The Crown, Netflix's German original series The Empress is a beautiful, intriguing series that combines the best elements from both shows.

Sebagaimana diketahui, chronicling empress elisabeth’s life in the 19th century, this dramatized true story is an absolute joy to watch, elevated by its compelling protagonist and sordid royal drama. The Empress is by no means as steamy as Bridgerton, but matches the period drama’s swoon-worthy romantic focus. With the show’s final season now streaming on Netflix, The Empress deserves its flowers, more so because each installment is better than the last and has something important to say about mental health, women’s rights, and autonomy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, many tv shows start with a bang and promise great things to come. However, as they add more seasons and episodes, they fall off and lose the elements that made them so addictive in the first place. The Empress, however, is different. The period drama’s first installment earned an impressive 85% Rotten Tomatoes audience score, while its second season’s nearly perfect 92% RT audience rating proved the series was getting better.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the empress is so charming and watchable largely because of its layered, well-developed main character. By season 2, Austria is at war, and the Empress begins to hate her life as her duties take their toll. In The Empress season 1, Elisabeth is a naive girl who believes she has finally found her happily-ever-after ending when she marries Austrian Emperor Franz Joseph. The show's third and final season, however, is a true masterpiece.

Berdasarkan laporan, elisabeth, now grown and weary in the empress season 3, does what she does best: whatever she wants. The titular Empress has a vulnerability and fierceness in the show's final run that reminds audiences why they fell in love with her in the first place. Sure, her and Franz's marriage isn't always as strong, but their love endures, mostly because they bring out the best in each other.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, numerous movies and tv shows have dissected the british royal family, so fictionalizing their lives is nothing new. However, given how ubiquitous the royals are, it isn't always easy to handle their stories delicately, especially for a series like The Crown. It invited a lot of controversy during its run. Even beloved British icon Dame Judi Dench criticized the successful series, calling it “crude sensationalism” (via Entertainment Weekly).

Spanning 6 decades of British royal history, The Crown brought many real-life figures to the screen, and these ten performances stand out as the best.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the events depicted in the netflix series were still relatively new, or at least recent enough for people to remember — even during the first few seasons, which dramatized queen elizabeth ii’s earliest years as a monarch. People knew where they were when she was married, when she was crowned. There is archival footage of her reign. This issue worsened as the show went on. The backlash was inevitable.

Berdasarkan laporan, like queen elizabeth ii, empress elisabeth was revered. Still, Elisabeth was born in 1837 and died in 1898. Audiences were (and are) unlikely to scrutinize The Empress to the same extent as The Crown. The Crown couldn't avoid being put under a microscope. As such, her story still fascinates people, which is why it’s been widely documented and examined. That creates a safe distance and room for creative expression. Many of the people the show talks about are still alive — and their legacy is more precarious than ever.

All three seasons of The Empress are streaming now on Netflix.

"Marvin" became "Calvin," the rest of The Doghouse's cast was dropped, and while United Feature Syndicate still didn't take the resulting comic, Universal Press Syndicate did.

Berdasarkan laporan, before then, watterson had drawn cartoons about a spacefaring character as early as college. Watterson went on to make that character the focus of one of his rejected comics: a mustachioed, cigar-smoking parody of adventurers like Flash Gordon. Shortly after Calvin and Hobbes began, Watterson reworked "Mort" into Calvin's fantasy alter ego Spaceman Spiff.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over the course of calvin and hobbes' run, spiff was one of calvin's most frequent escapist characters. Whenever Calvin was caught in a boring or unpleasant situation, he frequently retreated into his Spiff persona to pass time or even make a hasty retreat. In practice, that gave Watterson a handy excuse to take Calvin and Hobbes' art well outside its usual mundane setting, with tons of gross aliens, impossible landscapes, and great phrases like "eat hot electric death" that don't usually come up in everyday conversation.

Diungkapkan bahwa much like the rest of calvin and hobbes, spaceman spiff really hit his stride in the comic's last three years, when watterson began doing his trademark "unbreakable" sunday strips. Some of the most colorful and evocative C&H comics are Spaceman Spiff adventures from the mid-'90s, but Spiff made a few solid appearances before that point. Here are some of our picks for the best Spaceman Spiff comics in Calvin and Hobbes.

Berdasarkan laporan, when calvin gets sick during his summer vacation, his first reaction is to get annoyed. Sick days are for the school year. I think we all can relate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately for all involved, calvin's mom takes him to the doctor. That includes a checkup, an injection, and a retreat into Calvin's Spiff mode, as he imagines himself as a prisoner of aliens rather than a little kid trapped in an examination room.

Sebagaimana diketahui, calvin's teacher mrs. Mrs. Most of her class are apparently boring normal kids who do the reading and don't get in unusual amounts of trouble. Wormwood catches a lot of strays in Spaceman Spiff cartoons. Sometimes I want to see a version of C&H from her perspective. Wormwood and Mr. Then there's Calvin, who's as much of a chaos agent as a six-year-old can be. Wilson from Dennis the Menace would have a lot to talk about.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this early installation, calvin gets called on in class and seamlessly incorporates mrs. (Look at those bug-men. Wormwood's history question into his daydream. Those are aliens that deserve the word "Hideous" being part of their proper noun. It's not being called on in class; it's being interrogated by the Hideous Zorgs of Planet X-13. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa the most extreme (in the '90s sense) spaceman spiff adventure was a week-long story where calvin got deeply enough into character that he staged a breakout from elementary school. Called to the board to answer a math problem, Calvin instead decides to shoot his way out (with a rubber band), then run for the door.

Sebagaimana diketahui, through what one assumes is the relative indifference of school staff, calvin manages to make it all the way home before his mom catches him. Unfortunately, Spiff can't get Calvin out of the ensuing consequences.

Berdasarkan laporan, right from the start, bill watterson has said that one of his primary influences on calvin & hobbes is george herriman's golden age newspaper comic krazy kat, which ran from 1913 to 1944. That was already some inside baseball in the 1980s when Calvin and Hobbes was new, as Krazy Kat’s modern following is almost exclusively made up of historians, fanatics, and other cartoonists. It’s not dead media yet, though, as historians and preservationists have made a point of keeping collections of Krazy Kat in print. Curious readers can check out Fantagraphics' George Herriman Library hardcover collections, which are still in print at time of writing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you check out krazy kat, its influence on calvin and hobbes is obvious immediately, particularly in its colored sunday comics. Herriman's characters inhabited a cartoonish version of the Arizona desert, and many of Watterson's Spaceman Spiff strips feature him visiting alien planets with similar arid backgrounds. This largely-wordless strip from 1993 is a perfect example, with so much of it devoted to Calvin's imagined spaceship journey from an alien valley to home.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of the best spaceman spiff strips comes in the last year of calvin and hobbes. Without dialogue, we see the entire comic from Calvin's perspective, as he's entertaining himself during yet another boring class by imagining himself behind the stick of Spiff's flying saucer.

Berdasarkan laporan, suddenly, mrs. Wormwood interrupts his daydream and breaks his train of thought. As soon as she isn't paying attention anymore, Calvin switches to a new scenario: this time, he's a dinosaur stalking prey.

#868. 5 Best Cartoon Network Anime Available Now On Netflix

📅 15 Nov 2026

5 Best Cartoon Network Anime Available Now On Netflix

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/best-cartoon-network-anime-available-on-netflix/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for an entire generation of kids rushing home from school in the late '90s and 2000s, or staying up way past bedtime with the volume turned down low, cartoon network was basically their first anime streaming service, long before streaming was even a thing. Nobody really cared whether Dragon Ball Z, Sailor Moon, or Yu Yu Hakusho came from Japan. They were just the coolest cartoons on television, and Toonami made sure every afternoon felt like an event.

Sebagaimana diketahui, launched in march 1997 with the iconic robot tom aboard the spaceship absolution, toonami introduced western audiences to some of anime's biggest names. From Naruto, Bleach, and One Piece to later hits like My Hero Academia and Dr. Stone, its lineup helped turn casual cartoon watchers into lifelong anime fans. Even after moving to Adult Swim's late-night Saturday block, Toonami kept that connection alive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sadly, finding those old favorites isn't as easy anymore. With streaming rights constantly changing, classics like Cowboy Bebop and Yu Yu Hakusho have left Netflix's US library, sending fans to platforms like Prime Video, Hulu, and Crunchyroll. Thankfully, Netflix still has plenty of former Cartoon Network favorites, including One Piece and Neon Genesis Evangelion. But beyond those household names, Netflix still has several other standout Cartoon Network and Toonami anime that deserve the spotlight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, few anime capture the feeling of late-night cartoon network quite like inuyasha. Created by Rumiko Takahashi and animated by Studio Sunrise, the series first arrived on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim block in August 2002. Those who stayed up until 2 AM watching Adult Swim will probably remember its haunting ending themes and the sight of Kagome and Inuyasha travelling through feudal Japan. It remained a regular part of the channel's lineup until March 2014, before returning to Toonami that November to finally air its 26-episode conclusion, InuYasha: The Final Act.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the story follows fifteen-year-old kagome higurashi, whose family shrine hides a well that sends her straight into japan's sengoku period. After accidentally shattering the wish-granting Shikon Jewel, she joins forces with the hot-headed half-demon Inuyasha to recover its scattered shards before the spider-demon Naraku gets his hands on them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, along the way, the pair are joined by sango, miroku, and shippo, while inuyasha's rivalry with his older brother sesshomaru adds another great layer to the story. And, of course, there's the complicated love triangle involving Kagome and the tragic priestess Kikyo. Both the original series and The Final Act are available on Netflix, making this a great chance to revisit one of Toonami's most memorable anime.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, before inuyasha became a late-night cartoon network favourite, rumiko takahashi had already given anime fans another classic with ranma ½. It was especially popular on late-night screens across Latin America from July 2006. Studio Deen's original 161-episode adaptation ran from 1989 to 1992, first reaching North American fans through VHS releases before becoming a memorable part of Cartoon Network's international Toonami blocks. With its ridiculous martial arts battles, wild transformations, and unmistakable '80s charm, it was the kind of show that made staying up past midnight worthwhile.

Berdasarkan laporan, the chaos begins when teenage martial arts prodigy ranma saotome and his father, genma, visit china's cursed jusenkyo springs during a training trip. After falling into the wrong pools, Ranma transforms into a girl whenever splashed with cold water, while Genma turns into a giant panda. Hot water reverses both curses, but that doesn't make their lives any easier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, back in japan, ranma is also stuck in an arranged engagement with akane tendo, soun's short-tempered youngest daughter. Their constant bickering is half the fun, especially with Ryoga, the hopelessly directionally challenged rival who becomes Akane's pet piglet P-chan, and Shampoo, a Chinese Amazon determined to win Ranma's affection. The original is a nostalgic treat, while Studio MAPPA's vibrant remake is now in its third season on Netflix.

Diungkapkan bahwa few late-night toonami memories are as unforgettable as staying up until 2 am on a saturday and hearing kamina shout about a drill that will pierce the heavens. Studio Gainax's 2007 mecha classic first reached American cable through Sci Fi's Ani-Monday block in 2008, but it found another home on Cartoon Network when Adult Swim revived Toonami.

Diungkapkan bahwa gurren lagann ran on the block from august 2014 to march 2015, bringing its wild mix of giant robots, over-the-top speeches, and pure hype to a new generation. Directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi, who later co-founded Studio Trigger and directed Netflix's Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, the 27-episode series remains one of the studio's most beloved works.

Diungkapkan bahwa set in a future where the tyrannical spiral king, lordgenome, forces humanity to live in cramped underground villages, the story follows timid fourteen-year-old digger simon and his fearless big brother kamina. Their lives change when Simon discovers a glowing Core Drill and a buried mecha called Lagann.

Berdasarkan laporan, after breaking through the ceiling to reach the surface, they meet sharp-shooting fighter yoko littner and begin a rebellion against lordgenome's beastmen. And yes, the show gets every bit as ridiculous and awesome as that sounds. What starts with a small team called Dai-Gurren eventually turns into a galaxy-sized war against the Anti-Spirals. All 27 episodes are currently streaming on Netflix.

Diungkapkan bahwa few anime openings are as instantly recognisable as case closed's jazzy saxophone theme. Gosho Aoyama and TMS Entertainment's long-running mystery series first arrived on American cable through Cartoon Network's Adult Swim block in May 2004 under the localized title Case Closed. It even renamed its leads Jimmy Kudo and Rachel Moore for the US audience. The series aired there until September 2005, while also becoming a regular part of daytime Cartoon Network programming across international regions.

Diungkapkan bahwa the story follows teenage detective prodigy shinichi kudo, who gets caught investigating a shady deal involving the black organization. After the syndicate forces him to swallow an experimental poison called APTX 4869, Shinichi wakes up in the body of a first-grader.

Sebagaimana diketahui, taking the alias conan edogawa, he moves in with his childhood crush, ran mori, and her bumbling private-eye father, kogoro. With Professor Agasa's tranquilizer wristwatch and voice-changing bowtie, Conan secretly uses Kogoro to solve impossible cases while searching for the people who poisoned him. Following TMS's July 2025 relaunch under the original Detective Conan title with a brand-new English dub, curated episode collections are now available on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, wielding a reverse-blade katana and hiding a blood-soaked past behind a goofy smile, rurouni kenshin gave early-2000s cartoon network viewers a samurai hero unlike anyone else on television. Studio Gallop and Studio Deen’s 1996 classic first hit American cable on Toonami’s weekday afternoon lineup in March 2003, instantly hooking kids after school before shifting to Cartoon Network’s Saturday night SVES block to finish its legendary 62-episode run through the Kyoto Arc.

Diungkapkan bahwa set in 1878 during japan’s meiji era, the story follows the former imperialist assassin once feared as “battosai the manslayer. ” Haunted by the lives he took during the revolution, Kenshin wanders the countryside under a strict vow never to kill again. After saving hot-headed kendo instructor Kaoru Kamiya in Tokyo, he finds a peaceful new home at her dojo alongside scrappy orphan Yahiko Myojin and street brawler Sanosuke Sagara.

Diungkapkan bahwa fans seeking a nostalgic journey need look no further. These ten Cartoon Network and Toonami anime are now available on streaming platforms.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, peace never lasts long as deadly figures from his past, including longtime shinsengumi rival hajime saito and bandage-wrapped mastermind makoto shishio, force him to draw his blade once more. Fans can relive that unforgettable journey on Netflix through both seasons of Liden Films’ modern remake and the five-movie live-action saga.
