#1101. 10 Best Western Movie Gunfights Of All Time, Ranked

📅 15 Nov 2026

10 Best Western Movie Gunfights Of All Time, Ranked

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2311599/best-western-movie-gunfights-ranked/

Sebagaimana diketahui, while westerns boast breathtakingly rustic vistas and memorably rugged main characters, chances are, we're there to see some sharpshooting gunplay. Many Western movies that everyone should watch at least once are anchored by a riveting action set piece between frontier gunfighters. These sequences range from drawn-out battles throughout harsh landscapes and dusty towns to quick-draw showdowns over in a single burst of gunfire. We're looking back at personal favorite gunfights in the history of Western movies, each earning a spot in cinematic history.

Diungkapkan bahwa silver screen legends like john wayne and clint eastwood immortalized themselves through the gunfight scenes in westerns they starred in. In many cases, the single most iconic scene in a given Western is its gunslinging action sequence. After all, the Wild West archetype is one revolving around its laconic gunfighters, not its bucolic communities on the fringes of civilization.

With those qualities in mind, these are the best Western movie gunfights of all time ranked, epitomizing the genre's gunslinging appeal.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so much of the classic 1953 western "shane" is the build-up to its titular protagonist finally showing everyone what he's got. When these homesteads are targeted by an unscrupulous land baron, Shane's lethal skills quickly come in handy. Played by Alan Ladd, the character is a drifter with a mysterious past who comes to work on a farm on the frontier. This comes to a quick-draw climax as Shane kills the murderous crook along with his sadistic hired gun Jack Wilson (Jack Palance), though Shane himself is wounded.

Berdasarkan laporan, ladd's shane is the ultimate gunslinger archetype, though he really only gets one gunfight in the entire movie. Fortunately, "Shane" makes this sequence count, with this violent inevitability expertly staged and crafted. To heighten the mood, much of this climax is filmed in a shadowy saloon as Shane overcomes the obvious trap that he knowingly walks into. Fans still debate over 70 years later if Shane survived this gunfight, which is a testament to how memorable the sequence and its ambiguous aftermath are.

Diungkapkan bahwa even though it became a western that flopped at the box office, the 2007 remake of "3:10 to yuma" does its 1957 predecessor proud. The 2007 remake features farmer Dan Evans (Christian Bale) escorting outlaw Ben Wade (Russell Crowe) to a train station, with Ben begrudgingly going along for the last run. That said, the difference between the two movies are most acutely felt in how they each end. What follows is a running gunfight against those trying to stop Dan, who still finds the time to convince Ben to cooperate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the last few minutes of the "3:10 to yuma" remake are its most exciting, while filmmaker james mangold still delivers on its main character arcs. Any sense of triumph is quickly undercut by the movie's tragic conclusion, differentiating it from both its short story source material and the 1957 film. The movie handles that fake-out marvelously while not mitigating the excitement that came before during this desperate run. Easily one of the greatest Western movies of the 2000s, "3:10 to Yuma" saves its best for last.

Berdasarkan laporan, for as breezy as the overall movie is, the most well-known scenes in "butch cassidy and the sundance kid" are its most relentlessly intense. Having relocated to Bolivia to resume their criminal activities, Butch (Paul Newman) and the Sundance Kid (Robert Redford) are ambushed by the authorities and take shelter in a nearby building. Though the duo being pursued by a posse across the Wild West for their train robberies stands out, the movie's ending is arguably its most famous sequence. Charging outside, Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid go out in a blaze of glory, with the movie ending on a freeze-frame as the pair are gunned down.

Berdasarkan laporan, the alternate ending of "butch cassidy and the sundance kid" thankfully wasn't used, which would've actually shown its likable duo gruesomely killed. " That freeze-frame approach works well for the overall movie, giving the story its inevitable ending but without dwelling on the violence, staying in line with its general tone. Instead, the scene leaves the carnage to the audience's imagination, rather than treading the same territory as the ending of "Bonnie & Clyde. The only gunfight on this list which doesn't show its decisive salvo on-screen, "Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid" focuses on its title characters' legend rather than its tragedy.

Diungkapkan bahwa john wayne led a lot of different western movie gunfights, from classic quick-draws in "the war wagon" to shadowy shootings in "the man who shot liberty valance. " Wayne plays U. S. Marshal Rooster Cogburn in the 1969 movie, finally catching up with a crew of outlaws he had been pursuing for the entire film. " But the Wayne-starring gunfight that stands out from the rest of his work is his climactic confrontation in "True Grit. After being insulted by the gang's leader Ned Pepper (Robert Duvall), an incensed Cogburn charges them alone with a gun in each hand and his horse's reins in his teeth.

Diungkapkan bahwa john wayne considered "true grit" to be his first decent role in 20 years, and his one-man charge cements his character's place in his legacy. The action sequence isn't just the movie at its most rousing, and it shows a more ornery side to Wayne's usual frontier archetype. Expertly twirling his rifle in one hand to chamber a new round, just as he did in "Stagecoach" three decades prior, Wayne hasn't lost a step. Putting a furiously gun-toting Wayne back in the saddle, "True Grit" proved this old dog still had some new tricks.

Berdasarkan laporan, over a decade later, "django unchained" is still quentin tarantino's biggest movie, at least from a commercial standpoint. The final act of the 2012 movie takes place in Candyland, a notoriously brutal plantation run by the cruel slave owner Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio). Subjected by Calvin's nightmarish hospitality in an effort to rescue Brunhilda (Kerry Washington), the enslaved wife of Django (Jamie Foxx), King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) kills Calvin. This kickstarts a particularly blood-soaked gunfight, as Schultz is killed and Django battles gunmen around the plantation, until he is eventually forced to surrender.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sanguine shootout may not be the final showdown in "django unchained," but it's a scene that we wish would never end. To heighten the effusive enjoyment of the scene, Tarantino uses "Unchained (The Payback/Untouchable)" by James Brown and Tupac, while making every bullet hit like an artillery shell. After the smug cruelty that Django and Schultz endure in Candyland, the action sequence feels like a cathartic release as Django exacts comeuppance on his hosts. The best gunfight that Tarantino has filmed to date, "Django Unchained" has its titular hero bring bloody retribution to its main villain's antebellum lair.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for much of "unforgiven," the violent backstory of outlaw will munny (clint eastwood) was only hinted at, with munny himself focused on being a farmer and single father. Storming into Little Bill's saloon, Munny shoots him and several of his associates, maintaining a clear-eyed, if furious, focus. After learning that his old friend Ned Logan (Morgan Freeman) was murdered by the sadistic sheriff Little Bill Daggett (Gene Hackman), with his body mockingly displayed, Munny's lethal demeanor resurfaces. After finishing off Little Bill, Munny threatens everyone to properly bury Logan or experience his wrath again before departing from the rainy frontier town for good.

Diungkapkan bahwa the "unforgiven" ending reveals that some legends are better left to fade away, and munny is every inch the killer that he was reputed to be. Keeping in tone with the rest of the revisionist Western nature of the movie, this burst of violence isn't particularly flashy or stylized. Moreover, Munny inadvertently demonstrates Little Bill's own insight against him, staying calm and collected during the chaos of the gunfight, allowing him to take down all his enemies. But that makes the carnage all the more grounded and with understated menace as Eastwood delivers his definitive word on the genre that made him a star.

Berdasarkan laporan, the most famous shootout in real wild west history was the gunfight at the o. Corral in 1881 between the Cowboy outlaw gang and lawmen led by Wyatt Earp. K. Though this fateful showdown has been dramatized plenty of times in Western movies, the most entertaining depiction is in "Tombstone. " Roughly serving as the centerpiece of the movie, the scene only lasts less than a minute, like the historical event. Several of the outlaws are killed in the exchange, while both of Wyatt's brothers are wounded before inciting the wrath of the other gang members.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "tombstone" presents its historical figures in a stylized and colorful light, helping make it one of the best western movies of the 1990s. K. Corral is played relatively straight, which helps it stand out from the rest of the movie. The action is quick, brutal, and consequential, setting in motion the back half of the movie's stakes. Comparatively, the gunfight at the O. Certainly one of the best gunfights in a relatively modern Western movie, "Tombstone" knows a lot is riding on its marquee confrontation and delivers accordingly.

Diungkapkan bahwa the single most recognizable shot in sergio leone's "once upon a time in the west" is the sight of three gunmen confronting harmonica (charles bronson) at a train station. This sets the stage for Harmonica's arrival, earning his nickname from his first appearance with a screeching melody played from his mouth organ. The scene opens the film, playing out largely with diegetic noise as the three gunfighters await the incoming train with their target. Unfazed that he's outnumbered three-to-one, Harmonica takes his position against his three enemies and guns them all down singlehandedly though wounded in the skirmish.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "once upon a time in the west" is bookended with genre-defining gunfights, but the opening sequence is the superior of the two. With Leone, it was all about finding ways to fuel that tension before letting it finally go off like a pressure cooker, a lesson that has visibly influenced Quentin Tarantino. Leone's masterful positioning his actors in frame and suspense building until the inevitable draw finally punctuates that crescendo with a single exchange of gunfire. "Once Upon a Time in the West" is among Charles Bronson's best movies and seeing him anchor the movie's opening gunfight sets the mood for Leone's requiem to the genre.

Diungkapkan bahwa if "once upon a time in the west" is best known for its opening, the following year's "the wild bunch" is best known for its ending. The ensemble get caught up in the revolution south of the border, culminating in the quartet making their last stand against the full might of the Mexican army. The movie follows a group of aging American outlaws in the early 20th century, led by Pike Bishop (William Holden), who flee to Mexico after a botched bank heist. Gathering around a machine gun emplacement, the group are eventually overwhelmed and killed but not before massacring scores of soldiers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the gruesome to "the wild bunch" was reportedly as brutal to film as it was to watch, heightening the verisimilitude of the sequence. There's no mistaking that these four men are marching quietly to their deaths, but as the scene reveals, they're going out on their own terms and they're not going alone. In a matter of seconds, this situation escalates out of control, full of fire and fury as Pike and his associates stand in the face of oblivion. More than just the tale of four old outlaws, "The Wild Bunch" signals that the Wild West era didn't die out peacefully but with a violent fire in its guts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course a clint eastwood western was going to top this list, and of course it was going to be "the good, the bad and the ugly. The movie reaches its crescendo when it brings its titular trio together in a sprawling cemetery as they search for a hidden stash of loot. " Virtually every Sergio Leone Western, like "Once Upon a Time in the West," has a standout shootout sequence, but the greatest is in his 1966 epic. With the three gunslingers at odds, the characters have a tense staredown before Blondie (Eastwood) guns down Angel Eyes (Lee Van Cleef).

Berdasarkan laporan, powered by a stirring score by ennio morricone, the climax is one of the most effectively staged sequences leone has ever directed. The intercutting of close-ups between the three main characters before being punctuated by a single burst of gunfire with mounting suspense all the while is masterfully done. The moment also provides Blondie with another opportunity to pull a fast one on Tuco (Eli Wallach), secretly unloading his pistol for the duel. The quick-draw gunfight that epitomizes Leone's meticulous style, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly" ends on a truly iconic note.

#1104. The 2026 GOTY Race Could Be a Disaster for Indie Games

📅 15 Nov 2026

The 2026 GOTY Race Could Be a Disaster for Indie Games

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/goty-2026-game-awards-indie-big-walk-ai/

After three indie nominees last year, this year’s leading contender is in trouble.

Diungkapkan bahwa last year was a watershed moment for indie games at the game awards. Three games were nominated for both Game of the Year and Best Independent Game: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Hades 2, and Hollow Knight: Silksong. Together, they made up half of the GOTY 2025 field.

Berdasarkan laporan, some quibble with the definition of clair obscur, a sizable production, as an indie game. (For what it's worth, the studio that made it is independent, and its publisher Kepler Interactive was founded by a collective of indie studios; it's definitely culturally indie. ) But even if you excluded it, this was still the first time more than one game had crossed over between the indie and GOTY categories in the history of the awards.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you interpret this result as a sure sign that the game awards is taking indie games much more seriously, i'm afraid you might be disappointed. All three 2025 indie GOTY nominees were huge sellers, and two of them were high-profile sequels to critical darlings and popular favorites. In previous years things were much more patchy. These were not normal times. There was no indie nominee in 2023. The 2025 nominations flatter to deceive, and 2026 looks like it will be a different matter. Balatro, 2024's indie nominee, was a massive viral hit. In 2022, the lucky game was the distinctly slick and mainstream Stray. Prior to that, one indie game would typically break through every other year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, increasing recognition of indie games among the critical community has been counterbalanced by the international expansion of the game awards jury. This expansion has tended to flatten the jury's taste, and tends to disadvantage indie developers who can't afford localization into multiple languages — not an issue for 2025's three big beasts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so we turn to the 2026 race. There have been some superb and well-reviewed indie games this year, as there are every year: Big Walk, Mina the Hollower, Zero Parades, Mewgenics, Cairn, Denshattack!, Mixtape. None of them have been hits on the scale of the last few indie nominees, however, nor have they penetrated the culture in the same way as 2025’s games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nevertheless, a nomination for one of them is still in prospect, because this year's goty slate is relatively weak, with many evenly matched titles fighting over the few nomination slots left after dead certs grand theft auto 6, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time, and resident evil requiem are accounted for. In those circumstances, there's a path to nomination for an indie game with a stellar critical reputation and strong support.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the best candidates are mina the hollower and big walk, both critical darlings with 90-plus ratings on metacritic. As a multiplayer co-op game, Big Walk has had a longer tail in the conversation, and has more viral stickiness. Mina was more widely covered at launch, but didn't click with a big audience. Jury members have probably been playing it over time with their friend groups. It's been my pick of the two so far, and its case was buoyed by a win in the Critic's Choice category at this week's Golden Joystick Awards.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, also this week, developer house house made the disastrous admission that generative ai had been used to write some code for big walk. (The Indie Game Awards stripped Clair Obscur of its 2025 Game of the Year award over use of generative AI. This will likely rule the game out of contention for several indie awards, like the IGF and Indie Game Awards. ) Its impact on Big Walk's fortunes at The Game Awards is less clear.

Diungkapkan bahwa the broad-church game awards jury is likely less swayed by ethical issues such as ai usage than small, indie-specialist juries. That said, Big Walk will need the whole indie-fan coalition within The Game Awards jury to rally around it if it's going to get a nomination. An added wrinkle is that the AI news hit toward the final stage of The Game Awards' two-step nomination process. Jury members offended by the AI usage would have to actively remove Big Walk nominations they'd already made, rather than just not make them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the controversy might not hurt big walk's chances as much as you might think, but it certainly doesn't help them. In a tight race for those final nominations, the leading indie contender just took a big knock. Can Mina the Hollower take up the mantle? Or will Big Walk's loss be some AAA title's gain — Control Resonant, perhaps, or 007 First Light? We'll find out soon enough.

What’s in pole position for gaming’s top prize? Let’s make some predictions.

#1106. Leonard Nimoy Loved This Star Trek Episode That Allowed Him To Show Off A Different Side Of Spock

📅 15 Nov 2026

Leonard Nimoy Loved This Star Trek Episode That Allowed Him To Show Off A Different Side Of Spock

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2311024/leonard-nimoy-star-trek-episode-different-side-spock/

Diungkapkan bahwa what was leonard nimoy's favorite "star trek" episode? it's almost a trick question. Human beings are constantly changing and fickle creatures; the answer to our favorite anything can change depending on our moods. Nimoy, who played Spock for almost 50 years, couldn't be expected to give one consistent answer for that long.

Berdasarkan laporan, but there are a few episodes that nimoy consistently named among his favorites, including in his 1975 autobiography "i am not spock. " The Enterprise visits colony world Omicron Ceti III, home to a plant species that secretes spores that take root in humanoid hosts. " One of them was "This Side of Paradise," co-written by D. Fontana and Nathan Butler and one of the best Spock episodes of "Star Trek. C. (The story is a likely reference to the Lotus-Eaters in "The Odyssey. Once they do, the hosts remain in a state of perfect bliss, but they also lose all their ambition. ").

Sebagaimana diketahui, spock is one of the infected. His stone face cracks into rubble as he becomes joyful, happily expressive, and even rekindles a romance with local botanist Leila Kalomi (Jill Ireland). Nimoy wrote in "I Am Not Spock" that he enjoyed the episode for showing Spock in a mood we almost never saw him — not coldly logical, sarcastic, or struggling to control his emotions, but genuinely carefree.

Berdasarkan laporan, "this is a very special episode for me for obvious reasons and particularly because, where spock was so totally adult in most of his attitudes and reactions throughout the series, this episode provided a chance to expose the complete child within. It was a total exposure of internal Spock that so many people have always suspected was there. We saw him loving, picnicking, romping, and literally swinging playfully in the trees. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa watching "this side of paradise" now, it might remind you of the apple tv series "pluribus," where all of humanity is turned into a blissful hive mind (collectively "the others"). In "This Side of Paradise," strong negative emotions literally destroy the spores, which is also a weakness of the Others in "Pluribus. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in "this side of paradise," though, there's no identity theft. Compare other times we see Spock's emotions come out, like in "The Naked Time" where he cries over having never told his mother he loved her, or "Journey to Babel" where said mother, Amanda (Jane Wyatt), recounts how Spock used to cry because other Vulcan children bullied him. The spores let Spock be his innermost self. As only a half-Vulcan, Spock is especially self-conscious about living up to his people's teachings about logic.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when the spores hit him, those anxieties melt away. Note how Leila says to him he has "no need to hide [his] inner face anymore" and Spock says "I can love you," as if finally allowing himself something he'd previously denied.

Berdasarkan laporan, nimoy described other "star trek" episodes as favorites such as "devil in the dark," where the enterprise crew visit a mining colony to find a creature killing the inhabitants. The culprit, a Horta (resembling a pile of living molten lava), is sentient and Spock telepathically communicates with it, discovering it was only acting to protect its offspring. Nimoy praised that one as a "wonderful episode about the fear of the unknown," and "Devil in the Dark" is known to be a favorite of William Shatner's, too.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "devil in the dark" and "this side of paradise" are very different episodes, but both ones anchored by spock. Little surprise that Leonard Nimoy loved them.

Berdasarkan laporan, there is no question that raymond babbitt in rain man is one of dustin hoffman’s most celebrated roles. The movie, which can be seen with an HBO Max subscription, received widespread acclaim, winning Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Original Screenplay at the 1989 Oscars. Hoffman won his second career Oscar for the role in the Barry Levinson-directed hit co-starring Tom Cruise as Ray’s brother, Charlie. Cruise, however, wasn’t nominated (he has still never won an Oscar), which is a shame, because not only is he great in Rain Man, but he also played a key role in Hoffman staying with the movie, even though he “fired himself” on the first day of filming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the legendary hoffman recently sat down with gq to do a career retrospective, and when talking about rain man, he told the story of how he really hated the way things were going on the first day of production. He thought his own performance of the autistic Ray was so poor that he told Levinson he would be happy to pay for the time, but he wanted to bail out early. Hoffman said of that first day:.

Diungkapkan bahwa it was a scene where we're standing around a car, tom cruise and i, and i said i'm quitting. What I say sounds like…like five different parts I played in films. And I knew it was awful, and it was. And I went up to the director, Barry Levinson, and I said, ‘I'm firing myself. I don't know what I'm doing. I can't do this. I'm putting them all [together] because I don't know what I'm doing. It's awful. ’.

Berdasarkan laporan, levinson, to his credit, didn’t want to hear that from hoffman and convinced him to stick with it for a couple of weeks, because he trusted that hoffman would find the character. So Hoffman stayed on, but still had serious doubts. They went on for a few days, and Hoffman was still frustrated, unable to really find Raymond’s core.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while praising cruise for his work ethic (and presumably his patience), hoffman talks about another scene between the two actors as they drive across the country later in the movie. Shot after shot, Cruise was ad-libbing, and Hoffman, in his own words, explains that he just hated what he (Hoffman) was doing across from Cruise:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we had to do a scene where we're both in the car. He's driving, and I'm sitting in the passenger seat. We do it two or three times, and I can't do it. It's about 10 minutes of film in each camera. So, you know, do the 10 minutes that's in each [reel] and then just improvise. And so when we were doing the scene, and he was brilliantly improvising.

Diungkapkan bahwa this goes on for reel after reel, and hoffman still isn’t feeling it. He went one:.

Berdasarkan laporan, we do it, we do it for hours. And on the two-shot, on both of us, Tom is asking me questions, and all I'm saying is, ‘Yeah,’ because I don't know what the fuck else to say. And I say to Barry, I can't, I really can't do it. He says, come here, I think, I think I found something. I don't have an idea of this guy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what levinson had found in those scenes was that hoffman had ray. He had found the character, and the rest is history. Rain Man and Dustin Hoffman would go on to win all those awards, and the movie remains, almost 4 decades later, one of the most beloved movies of the era. Hoffman realized that Levinson was right. It really is too bad Cruise didn’t get the recognition he clearly deserved for one of his best roles.

#1109. Anne Hathaway's 2024 Romance Movie Is A Must-Watch For Colleen Hoover Fans

📅 15 Nov 2026

Anne Hathaway's 2024 Romance Movie Is A Must-Watch For Colleen Hoover Fans

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2310687/anne-hathaway-romance-movie-must-watch-colleen-hoover-fans-the-idea-of-you/

Diungkapkan bahwa we're in a golden age of romance movies based on popular books, over which presides queen colleen hoover. But there's no denying it can be fun to settle down with a film you know is going to be absolute nonsense and just turn off your brain while two hot people fall in love and do it and stuff. Unfortunately, once you've watched the four Hoover films, you're stuck with the books until the author decides which of her stories to adapt next. There have been four movies based on Colleen Hoover novels and they've thus far ranged from sort of okay to entirely forgettable. In the meantime, may I direct your attention to a romance starring Anne Hathaway and Nicholas Galitzine, which at least tries to be more than an excuse for more hot people doing it scenes.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the idea of you" sees hathaway falling for he-man in a romantic comedy that, wouldn't you know it, is based on a book — because hollywood will seemingly only green-light love stories if they've been pre-approved by booktok. This one adapts actress turned author Robinne Lee's 2017 novel of the same name, in which she tackled the notion of women losing their desirability post-40. The movie similarly explores this idea via Hathaway and Galitzine's age gap relationship, and did so successfully for the most part.

Diungkapkan bahwa hathaway, of course, starred in the latest hoover adaptation, the dead-on-arrival "verity," which was helmed by "the idea of you" director michael showalter. Sadly, for those expecting a fairly straightforward romance, the "Devil Wears Prada" star spent a good chunk of the movie sitting motionless and glaring at Dakota Johnson while she stole her husband. "The Idea of You," however, was a much better Showalter x Hathaway collab, and it's available to stream right now on Prime Video.

Diungkapkan bahwa with its older-woman-falls-for-boy-band-singer narrative, you'd be forgiven for thinking "the idea of you" is a movie that started as fanfiction. "The assumption was that we ceased to be sexual beings and were thus less valuable. " Lee, who criticized those who dubbed her book "fluff" or "fanfiction," saw her story as being about "a woman's midlife sexual awakening," and strove to ensure it was both "tantalizing and complex. But in a 2024 TIME article, Robinne Lee pushed back against interpretations of her book being Harry Styles fanfiction and explained the real impetus for her story. "I was learning the hard way that in Hollywood, after 40, women are much less desirable," she wrote. I was eager to prove the industry—and our culture at large—wrong, in my own little way. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, much of that is preserved in the 2024 film adaptation, which michael showalter co-wrote with jennifer westfeldt. Despite there being several years between the two, Solène and Hayes share an instant connection and embark on a passionate love affair. Anne Hathaway plays single mother and art gallery owner Solène Marchand, who accompanies her teenage daughter to Coachella. There, she meets Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), the lead singer of boy band August Moon and all round handsome English gent. But the latter's popstar status invites scrutiny, and as you might expect given Lee's explanation of her novel, most of it is an excuse to attack the 40-year-old Solène for being with a younger man and generally hurl misogynistic abuse.

Can the pair's relationship survive? You'll have to watch "The Idea of You" on Prime Video to find out — which, if you're reeling from the absolute nonsense that was "Verity," is well worth doing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "the idea of you" premiered at the 2024 south by southwest film festival before going straight to amazon prime video in may of that year. While that direct-to-streaming trajectory might typically indicate a less than stellar romantic comedy, "The Idea of You" actually earned some impressive reviews — a testament to Robinne Lee's efforts to go beyond your typical romantic fiction fare as well as Michael Showalter and Jennifer Westfeldt's ability to preserve that effort in their adaptation.

Diungkapkan bahwa on rotten tomatoes, the film holds a very respectable 81% "certified fresh" critic score — a damn sight better than the 32% "verity" managed to eke out. " Otherwise, reviewers were won over by Anne Hathaway and Nicholas Galitzine's chemistry and performances. /Film's Ryan Scott was certainly impressed, writing in his "The Idea of You" review, "this is the genre at its best. That's to be expected in Hathaway's case. The actor is usually the best thing about any movie she's in, and while there are arguably more compelling modern Hathaway performances — her chilling 2023 thriller that flew completely under the radar, "Eileen," being one example — she does a fine job in "The Idea of You," conveying all the vulnerability and strength of the Solène Marchand in Lee's original novel.

Sebagaimana diketahui, galitzine, meanwhile, is also perfectly charming if a bit too impressed with himself. The man is no stranger to romance stories, either, having starred alongside Netflix's romance queen Sofia Carson in 2022's "Purple Hearts" (watch that if you want a more straightforward romantic drama). Otherwise, "The Idea of You" is a great palette cleanser for recovering "Verity" viewers but should also go down well with Colleen Hoover fans craving a bit more romance from their Hathaway-led entertainment.

While the announcement was meant to be celebratory, it has reminded people of the falling out that Super Meat Boy and Mewgenics creator Edmund McMillen has had with Team Meat, as he is not involved in the new project.

Berdasarkan laporan, team meat describes super meat boy again+ on its steam page as "everything you remember from super meat boy presented through the wonderful lens of nostalgia with stuff added to it. " In practice, that means it's a remake with art, music, cutscenes, and secrets for players to discover. Super Meat Boy Again+ does not currently have a release window.

Diungkapkan bahwa we learned shortly after super meat boy again+'s reveal that edmund mcmillen wasn't involved in the project, despite being a co-creator of the franchise. On X, he posted the GIF of Homer Simpson backing up into bushes in response to a Wario64 post about the game's announcement. When another X user asked if he had anything to do with Super Meat Boy Again+, McMillen simply replied, "It's all news to me man. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, edmund mcmillen co-founded team meat and designed the original super meat boy, but he had left the studio by 2017. Since then, co-founder and programmer Tommy Refenes has continued to run Team Meat as CEO and has expanded the franchise since McMillen's departure with games like Super Meat Boy Forever, Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine, and this year's Super Meat Boy 3D.

Berdasarkan laporan, none of those games have been able to reach the same level of critical acclaim as super meat boy. Earlier this year, Polygon's Giovanni Colantonio wrote that "Super Meat Boy 3D makes me feel like the series has run out of questions to ask, and that’s a dangerous creative place to be stuck in. " The announcement of Super Meat Boy Again+ shows that Team Meat is content to just play its greatest hits over and over again.

Diungkapkan bahwa meanwhile, edmund mcmillen has continued his journey as an independent developer and found success unrelated to super meat boy. Earlier this year, he launched the raunchy cat-breeding tactics roguelike Mewgenics, and it became one of the year's biggest indie games on PC before making its way to consoles in September.

A charmingly churlish game where anything is pawsible.

Jonathan Roumie is ready for viewers to experience Jesus’ final day in a whole new light thanks to The Chosen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i think what makes it something that we’ve never seen before is we’ve never had the context and the lead-up with such detail and with such a devoted amount of time to storytelling,” roumie, 52, exclusively shared with us when raising awareness of the hallow app’s advent pray25 challenge launching november 30. “Five seasons prior, it’s about 40 hours of storytelling, and nobody’s ever done that before they get to the crucifixion. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, because of that, roumie argues that the prime video series has been able to create relationships, story lines and connection points to the faith and culture “that people haven’t really seen in such detail. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “it’s going to be a different experience because now, you’ve gotten five seasons of jesus laughing and smiling and teaching and healing and doing miracles and his sense of humor and in all these very human non-threatening environments,” he explained, revealing what viewers can expect in season 6. “And now it’s changed. It’s going to have that much more of an impact on people’s response to the crucifixion because they’ve had so much time to love this character and love Jesus and befriend him and feel he’s with them, and now to see him treated violently and terribly, it’s going to rattle a few cages for sure. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, roumie continued, “in the end, there’s no way around it. He chose it. And in order to get to the resurrection, you have to go through the crucifixion. He allowed it. There wasn’t any way around it for Jesus. Thank goodness. And he did it all for us. ”.

Season 6 of The Chosen, which begins streaming on Prime Video Sunday, November 15, captures the historic events of Jesus’ final day through the lives of those who love him — and those who condemn him.

The Chosen season 7 resurrection film is planned to premiere theatrically on March 12, 2028.

When the show first premiered in 2019, Roumie recalled far too many people ignoring the project.

Over time, people began to appreciate the story lines, production value and ability to tell Jesus’ story in a relatable way.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “our goal was to bring something that people could relate to, and people could connect with in a way that was engaging, thought-provoking, spiritually eye-opening and enlightening in some way,” roumie told us. “Even when we had no money, [we were] just making the most we could with what little we had. So fortunately, it worked. ”.

In addition to working on The Chosen, Roumie is honored to spread God’s message of faith, hope and love with his continued partnership with the Hallow app.

Starting November 30, Roumie will join Chris Pratt, Gary Sinise and more in a prayer challenge for the Advent season called: Pray25: It’s a Wonderful Life.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we’re so often surrounded by this cacophony, this constant chaos of noise and distraction and everything that sort of pulls us away from the real importance of what the season is about, and it’s about jesus christ,” roumie explained. “The amount of messages that Hallow receives from people who have just been searching or they’re lost, or they’re in some truly dire circumstances, and somehow the Lord directs them to find this app and start praying, and oftentimes they’ll find some meditations and prayers that I’m leading, and they just get sucked into this relationship with the Lord and with prayer in a way that for many people completely transforms their lives. ”.

As the holiday season approaches, Roumie paused to reflect on the many blessings he has experienced in the past year.

When asked to share what makes his life a wonderful life, the actor couldn’t help but give thanks to his Catholic faith.

Diungkapkan bahwa “it’s a wonderful life because the lord has taken me so far in my journey in this world, into places that i never thought i would actually get to go to,” he said. I encourage everybody to get to know God on a deeper level. Start praying today. Download the Hallow app and start praying with me. “Having an intimacy with him, getting to know him is what makes it a wonderful life. ”.

The Chosen is currently streaming on Prime Video.

#1113. ‘Rings of Power’ Stars Break Down 2 Major Deaths in Prime Video’s Lord of the Rings Series

‘Rings of Power’ Stars Break Down 2 Major Deaths in Prime Video’s Lord of the Rings Series

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/rings-of-power-season-3-deaths-interview/

The first batch of episodes include two major character deaths.

The first batch of episodes include two major character deaths.

Berdasarkan laporan, the stakes are higher than ever in season 3 of the lord of the rings: the rings of power. Númenor is on the brink of civil war between the new king Pharazôn (Trystan Gravelle) and the Faithful loyal to the deposed queen Míriel (Cynthia Addai-Robinson). Sauron (Charlie Vickers) is working on forging the One Ring that will bring all of Middle-earth under his control, recruiting powerful Ring-servants to lead his orc armies. Payne and Patrick McKay made it clear that no one is safe this season by killing off two characters who have been part of the series from the beginning. Showrunners J. D. Polygon spoke to the actors about their last moments on set and their time in Middle-earth.

This article contains major spoilers for the first four episodes of The Rings of Power season 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the story in númenor has involved a lot of family drama. His daughter Eärien (Ema Horvath) allied herself with Pharazôn and his son, Kemen (Leon Wadham), encouraging her father to renounce his faith and pledge loyalty to the new king. Captain Elendil (Lloyd Owen) is one of the leaders of the Faithful, a Númenórean group who believes in preserving the kingdom’s connection to the Elves and the Valar. She participated in the arrest of the Faithful’s leaders, though she helped her father escape.

Five years pass between the season 2 finale and the start of season 3, and they haven’t been kind to Eärien.

Diungkapkan bahwa “in season 1, i hope you get more of a sense of youth and hope,” horvath said. “This season, you start to feel her age and shame creeping in about what she's done, what she's been involved in. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, eärien seems to be loyal to pharazôn, and is even called in to help interrogate a man who tried to assassinate the king. But she actually helped the Faithful plan the attack, and she kills the captive to save him from being tortured and potentially revealing her secret.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the idea that even small actions matter is a pretty big theme in tolkien, and even though she's done some pretty horrible things, the way she's trying to right the ship still matters in this last episode, or in the last few years that she's been helping the faithful,” horvath said. “I think she’s an imperfect heroine. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pharazôn’s chief advisor belzagar catches eärien sneaking into his room so she can send a message to her father, and he lays a trap that winds up with elendil being captured by kemen. When Pharazôn confronts her with the truth, Eärien leaps out a window to avoid being interrogated.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “that's probably my favorite day that i've ever had on this job,” horvath said. He's always been the most important person in the room for her, and we've been in scenes together, but we've never gotten to really spar. I was really excited about that scene. I knew that she was going to die on the island, and I knew what her political leanings were going to be. “It's the first time I got to deliver lines to Trystan, who plays Pharazôn. I always knew what was coming. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the tragic story of the wood elf arondir (ismael cruz córdova) began in the first episode of the rings of power. A soldier guarding a village of men who are descended from allies of the Dark Lord Morgoth, Arondir fell in love with the human healer Bronwyn (Nazanin Boniadi). Bronwyn’s own son Theo (Nazanin Boniadi) was partially responsible for the destruction of their home after he discovered a magic sword hilt that led to the creation of Mordor. Bronwyn died offscreen from poison delivered by an Orc arrow, which prompted Arondir to dedicate himself to fighting the Orcs alongside Galadriel (Morfydd Clark).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in season 3, arondir wants to leave the fight to take care of theo, who took refuge in the númenórean colony of pelargir. In the meantime, Theo responds to Sauron’s call for Ring-servants and becomes a Nazgnagôl. He puts off their reconciliation to go on a dangerous mission with Galadriel to infiltrate the infamous prison of Gundabad. The two finally meet again at Gundabad, where Arondir tries to persuade Theo to take off his ring and leave with him. Theo seems to be on the brink of accepting the help, but when Sauron appears and compels him to kill Arondir.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “he's appealing to the last bit of hope of his son, knowing that he's been quite corrupted,” córdova said. It's a testament to Arondir. I'm still not going to let my light be taken by the shadow, by the darkness. He's like, ‘I'm still going to face you. “Sauron is extremely powerful, and once he corrupts anything, it's very hard to fight against it. ’ I think he's a badass. Until the last second, he's going to try to lead with love. ”.

The dramatic scene was shot over the course of a week, though Córdova said he’d been preparing for it for months.

Berdasarkan laporan, “it was very emotional, but i felt quite supported by my castmates and by the crew,” he said. I knew what our director Sanaa Hamri had in store, and I trust her blindly, so I knew that the character was going to be honored in the way that he needed. “I was going through a personal loss of a very dear loved one that same week, so the whole thing was quite charged, but I felt like I was in great hands. ”.

Arondir leaves behind his surrogate son, Theo, and his pet dog, who stayed in Rivendell.

Berdasarkan laporan, “he's just the most beautiful dog,” córdova said. “He was a pain in the ass, but he was such a lovely dog to shoot with. Elves love and revere nature and all living things, so I think he'll be very well taken care of. ”.

Córdova loved shooting with the dog so much that he went to some extreme lengths to get him in more shots.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “he did not want to stay still,” he said. “He did not want to do what he needed to do. Just shoot me from this side. But I really wanted him to be there so I said, ‘Bring the tube of chicken paste we're using, and I'll just make it work. He was a little pain in the butt, but I loved him. ’ They did and I smeared my entire face and my neck on that side with the paste that he loved. He was such a cutie. ”.

Peter Jackson's trilogy inspired a generation of fantasy films, but Hollywood often copied its scale instead of its humanity.

Now, we just need to hear Chastain sing “Why Don’t You Do Right?” and she’s a shoo-in for her own Jessica Rabbit live-action solo movie (if a studio ever chooses to greenlight one).

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, jessica chastain isn't the first person to ever channel the beloved cartoon character. Also, in 2015, Heidi Klum’s Jessica Rabbit costume looked just like the cartoon (and it was kinda scary). This past Halloween, 90 Day Fiancé’s Kara Leona had a perfect Jessica Rabbit costume, with her dark red hair matching her red dress perfectly. Chloe Bailey, dressed as Roger Rabbit’s wife for Halloween in 2024, was also very eye-popping with her sequined red dress, long purple gloves and cigarette holder.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while i think chastain's shoot would've been well-timed for halloween, i think it's refreshing to see her as the “drawn that way” icon after the fact. Her vintage, glamorous appearance is like looking at a red-headed Marilyn Monroe. It’s hard to look away.

Diungkapkan bahwa of course, there's also a good reason the character is so beloved, as she's not only her own woman but she also stands by her man (or rabbit). While some may say Rabbit is too attractive for Roger, she said in Who Framed Roger Rabbit that it didn’t take much for her husband to win her over. The show-stopping cartoon simply said, “He makes me laugh. ” In that way, she's not a vain character, and it's not hard to see why she's so respected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, needless to say, jessica chastain was born to wear this costume, and she once again proves that she's a truly fabulous star. Here's hoping this won't be the last time she decides to channel a beloved character of any kind.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can see why jessica rabbit is such a popular halloween costume by streaming who framed roger rabbit with a disney+ subscription. You can also watch Chastain’s new streaming release, Heartland, which is available with an active Netflix subscription.

Just your average South Floridian cinephile who believes the pen is mightier than the sword.

#1116. CBS Has Surprise Schedule Change With All 3 'NCIS' Shows and Spinoffs

📅 15 Nov 2026

CBS Has Surprise Schedule Change With All 3 'NCIS' Shows and Spinoffs

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/entertainment/news/cbs-has-surprise-ncis-ncis-origins-and-ncis-ny-schedule-change/

CBS is planning a schedule change for all three NCIS shows: NCIS, NCIS: Origins and NCIS: NY.

Berdasarkan laporan, after the network previously hit pause on new episodes earlier this month amid election coverage, the three shows will once again go on hiatus for the holidays. There will be no new episodes on November 24 ahead of Thanksgiving — with CBS airing past episodes instead before each show returns on December 1.

NCIS, NCIS: Origins and NCIS: NY will then wrap up again with midseason finales before they return early next year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the franchise started when jag aired on nbc from 1995 to 1996 before making the move to cbs and remaining on the network until 2005. From there, the TV universe expanded to include spinoffs NCIS, NCIS: Los Angeles, NCIS: New Orleans, NCIS: Hawaiʻi, NCIS: Sydney, NCIS: Origins and NCIS: Tony & Ziva.

NCIS: NY is the newest addition, which premiered in October with LL Cool J and Scott Caan leading the cast.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “new york is our most iconic city. It’s incredible, and it’s just really a microcosm of the whole country right here in one place with all of the diversity, the different boroughs, the different cultures all colliding and somehow managing to function together,” showrunner Byron Balasco exclusively told Us at the time. “That’s why you make a show here. ”.

Balasco acknowledged that filming in New York City came with highlights — and challenges.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “the weather is a challenge because you just don’t know what’s going to happen. That’s just a problem to solve,” he shared. “And the highlights are you can really put your camera anywhere and point it anywhere and something interesting is happening. We can go to a neighborhood that we write about and shoot there. But that’s it. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa he continued: “we always try to do that to keep it as authentic as possible because you really want people to feel like they’re at the ground level on the streets in the city with our guys. It feels lived in. The cliche is that New York is a character in the show, but we really do want to make it feel that way. ”.

Balasco hinted that NCIS: New York will appeal to CBS viewers regardless of whether they have seen other shows in the franchise.

Berdasarkan laporan, “our goal is to make a show that has the dna of the universe but is its own thing. We’ll be cross-pollinating with other shows. But right now, it’s about our characters and our stories and really getting it up on its feet and having people fall in love with the characters,” he concluded.

Diungkapkan bahwa ncis airs on cbs tuesdays at 8 p. m. ET, NCIS: NY follows at 9 p. ET and NCIS: Origins is next at 10 p. m. m. ET before streaming the next day on Paramount+.

Diungkapkan bahwa john mulaney tore into health and human services secretary robert f. Kennedy Jr. on Saturday Night Live, branding him a “dumbass. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “no one likes that guy anymore,” mulaney, 44, quipped during his saturday, november 14, standup comedy monologue. Now, no one likes him. “What a predicament to be in. I have right-wing friends who used to be into him. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa he added, “you dumbass! your thing can’t be the measles. That can’t be your project! Giving people the measles and hoping they [live]. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, (measles cases have reportedly risen to a 35-year high under kennedy’s tenure as hhs secretary, with the centers for disease control confirming 5,412 cases across 47 different regions this year. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, mulaney repeatedly referred to kennedy, 72, as “bobby” throughout his monologue, revealing that he’s “known that dude for more than a decade. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, “you shouldn’t be in the government if i’ve known you for over a decade,” he joked. “I know some whack-ass people!”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the comedian recalled that he was introduced to kennedy back when the future hhs secretary was working as an environmental lawyer. (Kennedy received a Juris Doctor law degree from the University of Virginia School of Law in 1982 and later earned a master’s degree in environmental law from the Pace University School of Law in 1987. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “he wasn’t really [a lawyer]. He would just join cases late if they were about to be successful,” Mulaney alleged. “He had this stupid organization in New York, they were called the Riverkeepers. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kennedy has been associated with environmental action in the hudson river since the 1980s, having formed the riverkeepers organization to help keep its tributaries clean. (The New York City Department of Environmental Protection has determined that the Hudson River is safe to swim in, though there have been numerous allegations of contamination in the past. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, “they were in charge of keeping the hudson river in new york city clean,” mulaney said. “That was his job. His old job was keeping the Hudson River — whose native fish was tied-off used condom — clean. That’s how good he is at jobs. Now, he’s in charge of all of our tummies. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, mulaney closed his monologue by comparing kennedy’s gravely voice to “the mom from goonies. ” (Kennedy’s strained and shaky voice is caused by a neurological condition known as spasmodic dysphonia. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, us has reached out to the u. S. Department of Health and Human Services for comment.

Diungkapkan bahwa saturday’s monologue was far from the first time mulaney has publicly mocked kennedy. During his Netflix “Night of Too Many Stars” comedy set in May, he accused Kennedy of cheating on his wife, Cheryl Hines, “like a dog. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “sorry for the pearl clutch,” he quipped. Sorry to drop that public domain information on the Hollywood Bowl. “There are some West Side people who know exactly what I’m talking about. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mulaney was seemingly referring to allegations that kennedy was sexting new york magazine reporter olivia nuzzi while she covered his 2024 presidential campaign. (Nuzzi and New York Magazine eventually parted ways, though the publication found “no inaccuracies nor evidence of bias” in her coverage. The publication claimed that Nuzzi, 33, had not disclosed her “personal relationship” with a candidate she was covering, though its statement stopped short of directly naming Kennedy. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa “the relationship was never physical but should have been disclosed to prevent the appearance of a conflict,” nuzzi told the new york times at the time. “I deeply regret not doing so immediately and apologize to those I’ve disappointed, especially my colleagues at New York. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, rfk jr. never directly responded to the allegations, only telling Fox News in September 2024 that he “never comment[s] on those kinds of stories. ” Hines seemingly downplayed the rumors about Nuzzi in September 2025, telling the “Katie Miller Podcast” that people should “consider the source. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i don’t know this person. Don’t know their intentions. I could guess, but I won’t,” she said of Nuzzi.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mary-kate and ashley olsen may be best known for their shared role as michelle tanner on full house, but the child actors -- who eventually left hollywood -- also launched their own cinematic universe of sorts. In the '90s and early 2000s, the duo starred in several TV and direct-to-video movies. For the longest time, most of these movies were only available to fans who owned the hard copies, but that’s starting to change as a handful of their movies have popped up on Prime Video (though one of my favorite titles hasn't been added).

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike most movies that are released, the highly successful olsen twins managed to retain all the rights to a majority of their films after buying out the co-founder and former manager of their entertainment company, making them their own bosses. It’s unclear what has changed, but it seems like the Olsens have realized how sought-after these films are to their millennial fans and have started to loosen the reins. This allowed Mary-Kate and Ashley to control how their films were distributed and thus kept them off streaming services. As a fan of the Mary-Kate and Ashley Cinematic Universe, I’m ecstatic.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as of writing this, eight mary-kate and ashley olsen movies are currently available to stream for prime video subscription holders. Four of them are from the early days of the twins’ career and were filmed while Full House was still airing new seasons. The titles include To Grandmother’s House We Go, a Christmas movie and the first of their television films; the Halloween flick Double Double Toil and Trouble; It Takes Two, a loose book-to-screen adaptation of Mark Twain’s The Prince and the Pauper; and How the West Was Fun.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are also four films from the twins’ post-full house days, including passport to paris, billboard dad, switching goals and one of my personal favorites and their final movie, new york minute. Needless to say, this is a sweet lineup, but can I just take a moment to highlight one flick that's not present?.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the rest of us were being "normal kids," the olsen twins were busy producing and starring in a total of fourteen movies between 1992 and 2004. Eight films aren't a bad start, but there are still a lot that need to be added to complete the Mary-Kate and Ashley Cinematic Universe. However, there is one movie that I need to be added ASAP: the 2001 flick Holiday in the Sun.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the film, mary-kate and ashley play the stewart twins, whose parents surprise them with a trip to atlantis resort in the bahamas over their winter break. I vividly remember being in awe, listening to “Island in the Sun” play as the twins jet off to the Caribbean. And if Prime Video needs another reason to get the rights to Holiday in the Sun ASAP, it also serves as Megan Fox’s film debut.

Berdasarkan laporan, as bummed as i and several other olsen twin fans are that holiday in the sun isn’t one of the eight featured on prime video (as of now), it doesn’t put too much of a damper on the reveal. After all, we’ve waited years for even one of their films to hit streaming services, and now we have access to half their filmography.

Despite there being no official word from Prime Video, news of the release did travel fast on social media, with fans sharing their joy on X:.

Berdasarkan laporan, i guess it’s time for me to pause my marathon of watching all the new and upcoming christmas movies and head over to prime video to revisit some of these gems. Maybe if enough of us watch, the streamer will add Holiday in the Sun or any of the other Olsen twins movies!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the harry potter film series may have ended in 2011, but its lead, daniel radcliffe, remains a household name. If you can believe it, the British actor himself said people told him he would have career troubles after his Wizarding World days. However, Radcliffe ultimately succeeded, and he recently recalled how all that happened.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after daniel radcliffe nailed his adorable, precious harry potter audition when he was 11, his life would change forever. However, the David Copperfield actor opened on The Old Man and the Three about how challenging it was for him in transitioning to life post-Potter. And I didn’t expect such a brutally honest take:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the thing i always say about potter and what it did for me in terms of like — towards the end of the films i started getting all of us started getting the question a lot from journalists of like, ‘what are you going to do after this?’. ’ And you know, actually as I look back and I'm like, I can't believe people were saying that kind of stuff to a teenager. The implication was always like, ‘Well, you're fucked now aren't you? What are you going to do after this? There's nothing left. It's a really crazy thing to say to a young person.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's a real shame that people suggested that to radcliffe and put so much pressure on him at a young age. From the outside looking in, it almost seemed like he was being set up to fail. However, that didn't necessarily mean the December Boys actor would be one of them. Diungkapkan bahwa so i think there's a thing that happens when part of growing up famous is that as you are trying to figure out who you are, you are getting this perceived version of yourself reflected back at you from like a million places and a million people all the time. And so you have to figure out what of that is not real and what you actually are and what you actually want.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after radcliffe spent so many years playing the boy who lived, i can really understand why he'd go down a path of self-discovery. And lo and behold, Radcliffe would eventually star in the Broadway show Merrily We Roll Along, which made tons of money and landed him his first Tony Award.

Sebagaimana diketahui, plus, we can’t forget that radcliffe got into “deeply fucking weird” stuff in film projects that would come after potter. To name a few examples, he played a farting corpse in Swiss Army Man, sported pistols for hands in Guns Akimbo, and showed his dark side while growing horns from his head in, well, Horns. Plus, we can’t forget when he put the weird in Weird: The Al Yankovic, which he described as his favorite film he did post-Potter.

Berdasarkan laporan, it goes without saying that daniel radcliffe has been quite fortunate, and he can openly admit he hasn't done it alone. He also credits the creatives he's worked with for hiring him:.

Diungkapkan bahwa so a lot of people were asking us like, ‘what are you going to do after this, and are you going to be typecast?’ and i think there has — i'm sure there is an element of there are some directors out there who particularly in the first few years after potter didn't want me in their movie because they're like, ‘everyone will just be seeing harry potter when they look at him. ’ But for every one of those directors, there was also a director that went, ‘Oh, I would like him in my movie because I want to be the person that reinvents him or that can show an audience this actor that they think they know in a different light. ’.

Berdasarkan laporan, well, there you go. It appears that directors wanted the credit to be able to help show Radcliffe’s versatility outside of playing a wizard. Of course, many filmmakers naturally become impressed when an actor knows how to step outside of his comfort zone and take on different roles. To that point, Radcliffe’s former Harry Potter director, Chris Columbus, was definitely impressed with the talented actor’s career moves when the franchise ended, saying his projects showed how “fearless” he was.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, even though radcliffe received a lot of negativity that his career would end once harry potter did, i’m so happy they were proven wrong. While the fantasy franchise will always be a career-defining moment, I’m glad that Radcliffe is thriving and continuing to test himself as an actor.

Diungkapkan bahwa for the first time in eight years, johnny depp is back on top of the box office. Ebenezer is set to easily earn the most in theater grosses this weekend, and in doing so, it leads us all to a pretty obvious question. Is Johnny Depp back?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the pirates of the caribbean lead was arguably the biggest movie star in the entire world for an extended period of time in the 2000s and 2010s before the fallout from his relationship with amber heard devolved into lawsuits, abuse allegations and tabloid headlines. You can take a look at the box office chart below, which has strong estimates thanks to some fine work over at The Numbers….

Sebagaimana diketahui, so, does this mean johnny depp is back? well, the short answer is probably sort of, as some are predicting. Hollywood studios care about success more than any other metric, and there’s a lot of success here for Depp. The long answer is a little more complicated. Ebenezer was reportedly made for less than forty million dollars, and while critic reviews are middling, fan response has been terrific with an A- CinemaScore. The Hollywood Reporter claims half of the people who saw the movie this weekend cited Deep and his make-up heavy role as the primary reason they went, and Deadline further claims that the movie is putting people in seats across the entire country, not just in certain theaters that cater to certain demographics.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, add the positive word of mouth to the fact that it’s a holiday movie, and there’s every reason to believe ebenezer will have a nice little extended run here in theaters. In short, it’s going to remind all of the executives and producers working in show business that Depp, despite his extended absence, is still one of the most bankable stars in all of Hollywood, even if we haven’t seen it since he was starring in the Fantastic Beasts franchise. He’s almost certainly going to get a few projects with elevated budgets coming out of this.

Diungkapkan bahwa we already know one of those is for sure coming. I think it would be a surprise not to see him pick up commitments for a few more movies in the wake of this success too. I don’t think quite Marvel-style $250M event films, but I think they’ll be the type of projects that will get wide releases and have high upside. That’s scheduled to hit theaters in March of 2027. Amazing Spider-Man director Marc Webb cast Depp in his next movie opposite Penelope Cruz called Day Drinker. We’ll see though.

Diungkapkan bahwa outside of depp, it was a pretty sleepy weekend at the box office. It should continue doing solid business for at least a few more weeks as a great option for families. Godzilla Minus One fell quite a bit more, but that’s not a surprise for a foreign language film with a passionate target audience. The Cat In The Hat held onto second place for its second consecutive weekend. The people who wanted to see that movie were always going to come out its first weekend, which is why it put up such a huge number en route to victory last weekend.

Berdasarkan laporan, the story wasn’t quite as promising for some of the other new entries beyond ebenezer. Ghost Soldier and How To Rob A Bank both struggled to find a wide audience and were barely able to top five million dollars. It’s unlikely either will be able to build off those disappointing numbers, but we’ll have to wait and see for next weekend when the latest edition of The Hunger Games looks poised to absolutely dominate in what could be a hundred million dollar money cannon.

Diungkapkan bahwa i love jackie chan. We ALL love Jackie Chan. You love Jackie Chan. However, I think we sometimes forget when we started loving Jackie Chan.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's kind of crazy to think, but some people's introduction to jackie was in the 2010 karate kid movie starring jaden smith (which i love, by the way). For others, they might have discovered him with Rush Hour (which even Chan himself seemed to not have completely understood). For me though, it all started with 1995’s Rumble in the Bronx, which I just rewatched the other day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’ve always loved this film, but honestly, after a rewatch, i don’t think most people remember just what an absolute gem this movie is. So, today, I’m here to remind you.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as a black dude, i love martial arts movies (honestly, who doesn’t?). The thing is, I’m usually into SERIOUS martial arts films, like stuff from the Shaw Brothers, JCVD classics like Time Cop, and old Bruce Lee joints. Then, in 1995, a movie came along that had everything I love about martial arts, but it was also funny as hell.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, enter rumble in the bronx, which basically changed the whole concept of what a martial arts movie could be for me. Here was a film that wasn’t just martial arts, but was a comedy. It was a film that had a lively cast of characters, such as Uncle Bill Ma (Bill Tung), Elaine (Anita Mui), the wheelchair bound, Danny (Morgan Lam) - who could play a Game Gear with no game inside, and Jackie Chan himself as Keung, a police officer who just wants to attend his uncle’s wedding until trouble arrives.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the fight choreography in this movie is so good (especially the warehouse fight!), and its humor also lands with the same impact. Rumble in the Bronx wasn’t the first movie I'd seen that mixed martial arts with humor - I did grow up in the age of Turtle Power, mind you - but it was the first that wasn’t based on a comic book that still had this sense of humor. Seriously, watch it again. It's probably funnier than you even remember it being.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i first watched rumble in the bronx when i was just a kid, and i seriously hated the villains back then. Well, I'm 43 now, and I STILL hate the villains, which is a true testament to just how awful they are to poor Keung in this film. Yes, the late Marc Akerstream as Tony is the main antagonist, and he's a pretty good villain, but even better is his underling, Angelo, played by stuntman Garvin Cross.

Sebagaimana diketahui, angelo is a true scumbag who is always getting his ass whooped, but also finds ways to mess with keung. I hated Tony’s henchmen when I was a kid, but this really infuriated me as an adult. The “best” scene is when Angelo and others corner Keung in an alley and hit glass bottles at him with a baseball bat, cutting Keung severely. It made their ultimate beatdown later on that much sweeter.

Lastly, can I just talk about how great the stunt work is in this film? It's not the craziest stuff in the world (we would see WAY crazier stuff from Chan in earlier films of his, many of which came stateside following the success of RitB), but when I saw his death-defying stunts in RitB - like a huge jump between buildings! - I was hooked.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and i wasn't alone. With the humor, action, and crazy stunt work in Rumble in the Bronx, it's little wonder why this film made Jackie Chan a household name - especially since it's set in “America” (Even though it was filmed in Canada).

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, i think people may have forgotten just how all of it - the humor, the action, the stunts - are just perfect in this movie, and i think you need to rewatch it for yourself just to remember. It's still really that good!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rich is a jersey boy, through and through. That said, he’ll take Chicago Deep Dish pizza over a New York slice any day of the week. He graduated from Rutgers University (Go, R. U. !), and thinks the Garden State is the best state in the country. Don’t hate. When he’s not watching his two kids, he’s usually working on a novel, watching vintage movies, or reading some obscure book.

One of the most thoughtful sketches SNL has given us in a long time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, snl is best known for its irreverent characters and sharp political commentary, but some of the best sketches in the history of the show are ones that make pointed observations about society. Think Mom Jeans or Meet Your Second Wife. We got another one of those bangers last night, and many fans felt so heard they weren’t sure if they could even laugh.

Diungkapkan bahwa the sketch in question is a fake commercial for an elder care service called sister. It recommends that instead of putting your loved one in a nursing home or spending thousands a week on professional care, you instead simply text your sister. She’ll drop everything in her life to come help while you continue to live your life as if there’s not a family crisis going on.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, normally when snl drops a sketch on social, all of the top comments are about exactly what you would expect. They’re observations about who is good in the sketch and who isn’t good in the sketch. They’re messages about how it is or isn’t funny. Instead, a majority of the comments on multiple platforms are about how the commentator either feels seen or feels called out. That’s not the case with this one. There are comments with first person stories and comments saying their real life is exactly what the woman in the sketch is going through.

The top comment on YouTube already has more than eleven hundred likes and pretty much tells the whole story….

Berdasarkan laporan, other popular comments on youtube included one woman saying she almost had “a stroke from rage” while watching. It was the same pattern on X too. A woman who works as an estate attorney said it’s “not funny” because it’s so accurate to what she sees every day. Others commented saying the part about the siblings who did nothing still getting an inheritance felt especially powerful since that was their real life experience. Several said they were going to use the sketch to have a conversation with their siblings because they felt heard. Others just commented the classic, "WTF?".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to me, this sketch is saturday night live at its absolute best. I’m not saying we need this level of pointed middle fingers all the time, but it feels especially meaningful when the show gives voice to a problem or frustrating dynamic in society that isn’t often commented on. Caretakers are an underseen and underheard from group in American society, and you can tell by all the big reactions to this sketch that they’re happy to feel heard.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a strong case could be made that this week’s saturday night live episode was the best of the season. In addition to this little slice of brilliance, we also got a musical about central park horses, a middle finger toward boomers who betrayed the principles of Woodstock and some fun character work. Guest host John Mulaney really delivered a ton of dynamite sketches that covered a lot of territory. Even Weekend Update was a banger and included a fantastic joke about Colin Jost’s doomed ferry boat.

Sebagaimana diketahui, snl is off for awhile, but the show will return after thanksgiving with guest host amanda seyfried, who should be spectacular in a very different way than mulaney. I can’t wait.
